[**June 22, 1978:** Charon, Pluto's largest moon, was discovered by James W. Christy and Robert S. Harrington at the U.S. Naval Observatory station in Flagstaff, Arizona. The moon has a diameter of 1,208 km (751 miles) and over one-tenth the mass of Pluto. It is named after the ferryman of Greek mythology, Charon, who carries the souls of the dead to Hades, the realm associated with the Roman god Pluto.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=1ba21de536ca43ec98dbc1a4fedfff0f&_e=AFk2hidKVbRyZnHkcZqu53TmupndPboWrU-wC687cKt_sasNZiNN8n1Lglf2FKBqc-edZ_AYiplz8RNflf9w2UaONfdgnPy_5ktnq-fOsQU5SEg9HKZKjMfx7Q8tHWqBotnq_l6Nc-GAdz1NhgZgg3vKSxurSBmKoiGyVAItbuJ0swccGriGZCnIeaOSuEmb9uVQgbZf1jzHHucZRH88qsOTvpbpnJhaJ13s6YcGgFss9JV_2ur2V6o-CG5U7u26) **Source -[britannica.com](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=1ba21de536ca43ec98dbc1a4fedfff0f&_e=AFk2hidKVbRyZnHkcZqu53TmupndPboWrU-wC687cKt_sasNZiNN8n1Lglf2FKBqc-edZ_AYiplz8RNflf9w2UaONfdgnPy_5ktnq-fOsQXebkbiPV8ZvIe-ZH2FiB8lSuiliZOZ6saG9bwn4NWBtkBVh78KF63XOaUQ7Tkc_rs9fiCaRo4T4Jgc-8z7pM2LR6b60oW2Tqe91qizL7LHeTi1l-z3KPpJhLSLeLxNe7bhB8e7tvdUPyk91DgIon6K)**

subject: Young Kim is at it again with partisan politics

body:
Friends,

Congressman Adam Schiff was just censured from Congress.

Republicans levied yet another partisan attack on him, accusing him of having a “political vendetta” against Trump when Congressman Schiff was investigating Russia’s role in interfering with the 2016 U.S. election.

Our representative, Young Kim, released a statement last week that she would not vote to censure Congressman Schiff.

But when push came to shove, she changed her vote and voted in favor yesterday to censure Congressman Schiff.

Friends, I’m not surprised by what MAGA Republicans like Young Kim are doing in office. It’s what they’ve been doing for years: launch foolish partisan attacks and divide Americans.

Honestly, I’m just tired of seeing this back and forth. There’s real issues that need to be addressed in this district, from affordable housing to healthcare to gun safety, the list goes on and on.

That’s why I’m running for Congress, friends. As a nation, we can’t afford to be drowned in petty partisan battles.

And a lot of you have already donated to my campaign which I’m really grateful for! I need your continued support and would really appreciate your help today.

DONATE >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_email_2023q2?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2023.06.22_B1_YoungKimVote

We need a leader to represent this district that’ll put our country over party.

Young Kim has proven time and time again that her allegiance is to her party first.

MAGA Republicans have taken over the GOP and for them loyalty to Trump is a litmus test. They’ll do anything to protect his name.

A lot of what these Republicans like Young Kim are doing in Congress just doesn't make sense. They keep worshiping Trump.

I’m running for Congress because my loyalty will always be to my country and constituents. Nothing can ever change that.

As I’ve been saying in my prior emails, your donations allow my campaign to thrive and stand up to Young Kim. So whatever you can donate today will go a long way in helping my campaign.

DONATE >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_email_2023q2?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2023.06.22_B1_YoungKimVote

Thank you!

– Allyson

Thanks in part to the advocacy of our affiliate, the Supreme Court voted to uphold Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, which protects communities of color from efforts to dilute their voting power through map manipulation. **This was a huge victory for our democracy!**
[Help win more victories for democracy:
Donate to the NDRC](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65251410/412822343/1068403165?amount=30&refcode=EM_RTI_20230622_FR_6AA_redlight922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE0OTZmMGZhLTVhMTEtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KMrw3HsFpFOFh6NKn1_jMselfax3gFyXHI9er65DlQY=)

**But here’s the bad news, team: Republicans aren’t giving up on their attacks on voting rights. Instead, _they’re doubling down_.**

Across the country, Republicans are working to:

❌ Implement new restrictions that make it **harder to cast a ballot**.

❌ Change the rules to make it **more difficult to protect reproductive freedom** through citizen-led ballot initiatives.

❌ **Suppress young voters** by closing polling places on college campuses and implementing new identification requirements. One GOP presidential candidate even suggested raising the voting age to 25!

The GOP will do whatever it takes to secure unearned power – that’s why A.G. Holder has said, **“We’re going to have to go state by state to protect voting rights.”**

# I need your help.
|
---
Dear Friend,
I’m in St. George tonight, for the debate. Momentum is building, and I couldn't be more excited about the upcoming special election. This is a crucial moment where we can truly make a difference and pave the way for a brighter future.
First and foremost, I want to express my heartfelt appreciation to all the amazing individuals who have already poured their heart and soul into gathering signatures. You are the backbone of this campaign, and I can not thank you enough.
Now let's talk about the sheer magnitude of what we are aiming to achieve. **We need to gather a whopping 7,000 signatures from registered Republican voters, residing in CD2, before July 5!** Our time is limited, and this is a challenge that demands our full attention and united efforts.
To ensure that my name is on the Primary ballot, I need your help. We are under our signature goal with only 14 days left.
**WILL YOU HELP ME GATHER EVEN MORE SIGNATURES?** Will YOU collect 10 signatures from registered Republican voters who live in CD2 this week?
**Where to get a petition to collect signatures:** Print a packet and get started today: [Click here](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=8d2e9778aa&e=6484bb6dd5)Pick up a packet at our [Pick-up/Drop-off locations](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=a8304fb765&e=6484bb6dd5) (You can also sign a petition at these locations) (Request a petition via USPS mail- reply to this email with your mailing address.
If we work together, we can ensure that my name is on the ballot and that the voters of CD2 are able to vote in the Primary election.
Let’s do this together,Becky

—**FAQ about Signature Gathering:**
**Who can gather signatures?** Any Utah resident, over 18, regardless of party affiliation or where they live.
**Who can sign?** Only registered Republican voters who live in CD2: [click here for a map of the district. ](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=5357a46705&e=6484bb6dd5)Due to the strange boundaries of our congressional districts, most people live within 30 minutes of CD2.
**How to gather signatures:** *Talk to friends and neighbors.
*Knock on doors!
*What should you say?_Knock on the door and step back.__Clarify that you aren’t selling anything.__Hi, I’m___________. I am a volunteer for Becky Edwards for Congress. I’m collecting signatures from registered Republican voters to put Becky Edwards’ name on the Primary Republican ballot. Adding Becky’s name to the ballot means that as voters we will have the opportunity to vote in the Primary election. I want to make sure we have the opportunity to vote in the Republican primary.__Can I get your signature?_
*Which doors should I knock?Start with your own neighborhood. Your neighbors are the most likely to help.We also have a website you can use on your phone to see which doors to knock for valid signatures. If you would like to use the website, please send an email to [andreamiller0116@gmail.com](mailto:andreamiller0116@gmail.com)
*I’d like to knock on doors with a group volunteers. _Great! Join our_[ _#TeamBecky Facebook group_](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=4daf928ecc&e=6484bb6dd5) _or_[ _BE Field Slack channel_](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=0ae980d99e&e=6484bb6dd5)

Minutes ago, Heidi stepped off the stage at the second Nashville Mayoral Debate. (If you missed it in person, NewsChannel 5 streamed it live on TV, their streaming platforms, and social media.)

Team Heidi

Heidi sponsored or co-sponsored over 100 pieces of legislation in her first year in the senate, including legislation to allow cities to offer paid family leave, increase funding for school counselors and reading interventionists, and make it easier to cast a vote.
Heidi is focused on sustainable infrastructure, economic development and job creation, fully funding our public schools and supporting educators, expanding access to affordable healthcare, investing in suicide prevention, making certain that vulnerable children in state custody are not falling through the cracks, and ensuring that every Tennessean - regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age or ability - can achieve the American Dream.

The Oregon Department of Transportation is pushing for tolling on I-205 and I-5 in Portland.

_**They've rushed through the process without a thorough assessment. Cutting corners that will negatively impact everyday travelers and neighboring communities!

clean_body: | | | | Sign the Petition | Peter, The Oregon Department of Transportation is pushing for tolling on I-205 and I-5 in Portland. But here's the thing. They've rushed through the process without a thorough assessment. Cutting corners that will negatively impact everyday travelers and neighboring communities! This is frustrating for hard-working Oregonians like you and me who will be affected by this on a daily basis. That's why I've written a letter to the U.S. Department of Transportation's Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), demanding a proper evaluation. We need to know the economic, environmental, and social impacts of tolling before moving forward. Now, I'm calling on you, Peter, to join me in opposing this proposal. | Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. | **Constitutional Carry Signature Gathering Begins**
SALEM, OR—June 22, 2023—Today, the Oregon Secretary of State’s Office provided Constitutional Carry for Oregon (CCFO) with the official signature sheet templates for Initiative Petition 2024-021.

IP-21 amends the Oregon Constitution with the addition of one simple sentence: “... includes the right to carry, without a permit, a concealed firearm.” The official ballot title reads: “Amends Constitution: Creates right to carry a concealed firearm without a permit; voids existing concealed carry restrictions.”

IP-21 in no way places firearms into the hands of felons or those otherwise unable to legally possess a firearm. Such individuals do not typically apply for concealed carry permits to begin with.

At present, 27 U.S. states are already constitutional carry states. Numerous studies have shown that within five years of becoming a constitutional carry state, violent crimes in those states drop and the number of victims in mass shootings decreases.

The process of gathering the 160,551 signatures for the initiative to appear on the November 2024 general election ballot will begin tomorrow. CCFO has until July 5, 2024, to submit signatures.

CCFO is a grassroots volunteer effort. The three chief petitioners are: Joel Pawloski, a retired Army Lt. Colonel in Marion County; Kerry McQuisten, the former mayor of Baker City in Baker County; and Jean Sampson, former city council member of Clatskanie in Columbia County.

Those willing to help circulate or businesses owners willing to serve as a permanent signing location should contact their county’s lead at www.ConstitutionalCarryforOregon.com. # # #

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6t4hs6d3uuou9kkq0qdpiimpe8dtcs8gnpo49ao_rp22sh2s8i66o77cli62ob2c3h2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsbiijo9133gd3n9jvk2e9ulljampe5l8f7l5t08_rp22sh2s8i66o77cli62ob2c3h2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsb6m8rcbo2q1g9c43k9k3t3jm2spsu566kck530_rp22sh2s8i66o77cli62ob2c3h2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: American Update
subject: "The Genesis Story" Online Course Now on DVD
body:
In this six-lecture course, you’ll explore some of the major themes of Genesis

This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c669191%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eDzJ2OC6Er0bxJCG5q7ysQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,

I hope you’re having a good day. I’m writing with some exciting news.

Hillsdale College’s popular online course, **“The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,”** is available on DVD.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c669191%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eDzJ2OC6Er0bxJCG5q7ysQ&sysid=1)In this six-lecture course, you’ll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

“The Genesis Story” is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student’s theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the President of Hillsdale College, Dr. Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it’s important to both faith and higher education.
< />
Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

These relationships are explored in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**For your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of Hillsdale College, you’ll receive the DVD as our thank you.**

To receive your Genesis DVD box set or to give it as a gift, please use the secure link here: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-genesis](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c669192%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ogH1BXxAGdIZT%2bfXkOspvA&sysid=1)**

As you know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of state and federal government funding--even indirectly through student loans and grants. That’s why your support is so crucial.

Your gift helps expand Hillsdale College’s national educational outreach efforts to educate millions of Americans nationwide, including our nation’s youth. Your gift will also help to:
* Increase the number of students taking free online courses, such as “Genesis.”
* Expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s digest of liberty.
* Establish and guide classical K-12 schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.
* Promote the principles of American constitutionalism through social media and the radio.

Friend, please use the secure link above to make a $100 contribution in support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach, and explore the beauty of the first book of the Bible with your new DVD set of **“The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives.”**

Warm regards,

Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Vice President
National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

THANK YOU!

We've just had a generous donor write a check for $2,000 and another $5,000 online in small dollar donations, which allows us to pay the attorney's retainer to move forward. This is great news! Thanks to all who have chipped in and several of you who have invested. Thank you.

We will still have to pay an hourly reduced rate of $100 to $500 for each attorney on our team based on their experience level. So we will still be asking for your great financial assistance going forward. This is not a fundraising gimmick, but an actual legitimate need as we move forward.

Thank you to those who have already given. Our attorneys are already proceeding with research. We have a fantastic team to help with our case. We have such a peace about it. The media is chomping at the bit to find out the names of our attorneys. We're not giving it to them because we don't want our good attorneys to be doxed.

We're already hearing reports from the legacy media and they are already misleading the public with misinformation. We will be sending you regular updates. Our goal here is to expose the malfeasance and disregard of Virginia Code and best practices outlined in Chapter 4 of the Virginia State Board of Elections.

A huge thanks to conservative radio show hosts Jeff Katz, John Frederick and John Reid for reporting the truth and allowing me to explain to the public what's really going on. We will be emailing out my interviews with them soon. Stay tuned for updates.

We're going to hold these bad actors accountable. If you want to help out, please click the link below to donate to the cause. We will need financial assistance paying our attorneys hourly rate as we move forward.

We're not backing down. We're going to expose malfeasance and hold people accountable who are not following best practices and the Virginia Code. We've already exposed the early voting machine conflict of interest shenanigans by newly elected Chesterfield GOP Chair Leslie Haley, who authorized the Glen Sturtevant campaign manager as the sole Republican representative overseeing the certification of the early voting computers. They need to come clean with the voters.

| We all remember when, under the guise of "public health", government officials ruined businesses, closed churches, and tried to control your life. Our governor declared many small mom and pop businesses "non-essential", destroying their life's work and their lives.. Now we see the Uniform Law Commission (ULC) attempting to expand the power of government even more so that when they devise the next "emergency", government officials can take more control of your life.[Sign the Petition](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/XpMjsIEoRuJQxsL4cZR7rw)The Mississippi Freedom Caucus has joined others across the nation in demanding this attempt be stopped! If government power is expanded across our nation, our constitutionally protected God-given rights will be lost. Governors and local politicians love the ability to control your life, but they must be stopped before it is too late.We need you to join us and put a swift end to this overt attempt to destroy the freedom and liberty that we enjoy. Below is a copy of the joint statement signed by 11 Freedom Caucus chairs across our nation. Add your name to this statement so we can deliver this to every Mississippi State Representative and Senator demanding they limit the emergency authority of the Governor and protect your rights.[Sign the Petition](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/XpMjsIEoRuJQxsL4cZR7rw)|

# _Bank Your Vote, Continue to Win_
---
Just a few weeks ago, the Republican National Committee (RNC) launched a new nationwide initiative focused on maximizing pre-Election Day voting — Bank Your Vote. According to the RNC, the initiative will encourage, educate, and activate Republican voters on when, where, and how to lock in their votes as early as possible through in-person early voting and absentee voting. This will be key to making Joe Biden a one-term president, holding the House, and taking back the Senate. Here in Indiana, we've already been outworking the Democrats on this issue, besting them in mail-in and early voting in the last election cycle — but we can do better. And we can do so knowing that Indiana's best-in-the-nation election security and integrity laws are protecting our votes. Indiana was one of the first states to implement a common sense photo ID law many, many years ago. And this past session, statehouse Republicans built on it, requiring those who submit an absentee ballot application to provide some form of ID, like the last four digits of their Social Security number and either a driver’s license number, state ID number, or voter registration number; voters could also submit a copy of their driver's license. Republicans — at all levels of government — are delivering for Hoosiers. That's why we must do everything we can to reelect them, including "banking" our votes. Sincerely,
---
---
Chairman Kyle Hupfer

# **Governor Holcomb's Week That Was**
---
| |
# _Future Farmers of (Indiana)_
---
| |
---
_**Governor Eric Holcomb** speaks during a roundtable discussion with business leaders in Portugal._**
---
This week, **Governor Eric Holcomb** spoke to over 1,200 attendees at the first general session of the 94th Future Farmers of America state convention on the campus of Purdue University. **What he said:**[According](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/098322e37b8191b2c3d6b838967d376c/40313) to the Purdue Exponent, **Gov. Holcomb's** speech "highlighted the advances in agriculture-related technology over the past few decades and in the last century."
* “'We’re not just growing plants, but we’re doing plant genetics,' **Holcomb** said. 'We’re not just growing livestock, we’re making animals healthier along the way .... and it all traces back to what you’re learning today.'”

**Future Farmers (in Indiana):** **Gov. Holcomb** encouraged attendees to plant their roots in Indiana, noting available career paths in every sector of agriculture.
* "'Think about what you can contribute to where our state is and where our state — more importantly — is going. You would be just as likely to be forging your future, not just out of the forest or in a field on a farm, but you might be forging it out of a lab. Or both.'”

_[See a few more photos here.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/30be9129dce59cacc3d6b838967d376c/40313)_

| | |

---
From __[_State Affairs_](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/5e2bf3def0b5f8b3c3d6b838967d376c/40313): "He calls himself the 'nerdy cowboy' — wearing boots with his suit and winning his election, in part, by driving his truck to far, less-populated corners of the state. "State treasurer Daniel Elliott, a farm owner from Morgan County, took over the Indiana Treasurer of State office at the start of the year, but he’s been involved in politics for about a dozen years. First as a precinct committeeman and then as a GOP county chair, county councilman and president of the local redevelopment commission." _[Story continues.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/e1aa9b1a41cc4a65c3d6b838967d376c/40313)_

# _Washington Examiner: House Republicans Endorse Largest Pay Raise for Military in Decades for 2024_
---
From [_The Washington Examiner_](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/7852e71ad602ec80c3d6b838967d376c/40313): [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/3cd58d38e5279b99c3d6b838967d376c/40313)"Republicans on the House Armed Services Committee endorsed the largest pay increase for military service members in more than 20 years on Monday in their draft of the annual defense policy bill. The proposed bill includes a 5.2% pay raise for all service members, with additional unspecified pay bumps for junior members. The raise would be the highest since 2002, and it matches President Joe Biden's request earlier this year, implying bipartisan support." "Other proposals in the House committee's draft of the National Defense Authorization Act to help troops that are feeling the effects of inflation include bonuses and more flexibility to adjust the Basic Allowance for Housing that would adjust to housing prices and help service members who live near the poverty line." [_Story continues._](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/3b1c08c9df23a9e1c3d6b838967d376c/40313) **What they're saying: **“I’d like to thank every member of our subcommittee for working hard to address the historic recruiting and retention crisis facing our nation, most significantly by passing the largest pay raise for our troops in decades," [said](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/a56409b6c119f935c3d6b838967d376c/40313) **Congressman Jim Banks**.
* "In my first year as Chairman, boosting military salaries ahead of projected inflation has been a top goal of mine, and I’m proud of our success today."

# _Hoosier Nominated as First Vice President of NFRW_
---
This week, Indiana’s **Monica Kozlowski** was nominated as the First Vice President of the National Federal of Republican Women for the organization's 2024-2025 term. **The details:** The National Federation of Republican Women (NFRW) was founded in 1938 and is the largest grassroots Republican women's organization in the country, with tens of thousands of active members in local clubs across the nation.
* In her role, **Monica** will contribute to the organization's mission of building leaders, empowering women, and promoting Republican candidates and ideals.

**Join up:** You can join a local club of the Indiana chapter by clicking [here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/74a951e22b18dcc8/e3f714bcf9ed62acc3d6b838967d376c/40313). Congrats, **Monica!**

# _Session Spotlight: SEA 8_
---
**The bill:** SEA 8 (prescription drug rebates and pricing), signed May 4, 2023. **The details:** SEA 8 requires that pharmacy benefit managers extend manufacturer discounts to customers in stores or to health plan managers.
* Pharmacy benefit managers represent millions of patients and use their leverage to secure lower drug prices; this bill ensures that the profit from these negotiations returns to consumers’ pockets.

# _The Latest from FactCheckBiden.com_
---
Over the past five years, amid constant investigation and scandal, **Biden** has insisted that his son, **Hunter Biden** , has never done anything wrong. In fact, Biden even maintained that Hunter did the right thing when accepting funds from companies affiliated with communist China. **The facts:** Hunter Biden has pleaded guilty to federal tax fraud and firearm charges, prompting consideration of what else Biden might have lied about.

**What is true?** The Biden family's shady business deals are only just beginning to come to light.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The truth about America’s Christian heritage
body:
Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26278%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bNS41gtTbNmTyBoLCUVU%2fw&sysid=1)
---
Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I’ve written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you’ll appreciate.
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26278%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bNS41gtTbNmTyBoLCUVU%2fw&sysid=1)
---
| | I would love for you to read this book and discover the truth about our nation’s Christian heritage. And as a token of our appreciation for a gift to Pathway to Victory, we’ll not only send you this book, but also a brand new CD featuring some of our nation’s most patriotic songs from First Baptist Dallas’ renowned choir and orchestra. **[https://ptv.org/donate/america-is-a-christian-nation-by-dr-robert-jeffress/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26279%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9VmTQdFsSxCoquE4x9Ek9A&sysid=1)**

Your donation will be matched dollar-for-dollar thanks to a $500,000 matching challenge that ends on July 4th.

As believers, we must preserve America’s unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. By understanding our nation’s Christian roots, we can work to bring our country back to its founding principles. At the end of my book, I provide suggestions for how to do just that.

I hope you’ll consider donating to _Pathway to Victory_ and receiving your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ so you can know without a doubt that the foundation of our country was solidly established in the principles of the Bible.

Gratefully,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqsaaa6onjnima2qq82urhmvi2pk7q5iec2je838_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj6ap32c5h2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb6622p1na43uho5r69rps6pe5faq3h2572p2eso_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj6ap32c5h2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zk1jodk8c95jii6jsf36dldtb7i10mfc7nvveifo_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj6ap32c5h2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8pds3pj2acfbaieqhkevd3u2bb8vfruvum8tgng_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj6ap32c5h2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Derek, no one
who gets elected to Congress imagines that they will one day be censured
by members of the other party for doing their job and their constitutional
duty.

But that’s exactly what happened to me Wednesday.

MAGA Republicans, with the support of GOP Speaker Kevin McCarthy, passed a
false and defamatory resolution on a party-line basis to censure me for
standing up to Donald Trump and for investigating and impeaching him over
his many abuses of power.

subject: The truth about America’s Christian heritage
body:
Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7i7s4q13fad62engiut45m1hoheu7564f7p2qc8_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj66p72cth2bs)
---
Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I’ve written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you’ll appreciate.

I hope you’ll consider donating to _Pathway to Victory_ and receiving your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ so you can know without a doubt that the foundation of our country was solidly established in the principles of the Bible.

Now, the future of our reproductive rights will be on the ballot again in 2024 – and the odds are stacked against us. Democrats are defending 23 Senate seats. Republicans only have to defend 10. That means they’ll have more resources to go on the offensive and target incumbents like me. And election experts at FiveThirtyEight are already saying that Mitch McConnell has a “clear path” to retaking Senate control in 2024. Protecting our pro-choice majority has never been more important – and to do that we have to win every single seat up for election. 14 years ago, I founded an organization from my parent’s home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.
| | | | [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z954fb04f0gtk720en887k62aj3vi44ocqdudghg_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)
[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhda7fvni86q7ih13oj3cbqrjn6c44jpqjp59fl8_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)
Dear Friend,

Fourteen years ago, I founded an organization from my parent’s home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

You’ve seen my work. Most Americans have.

In February, after releasing a historic investigation on Pfizer, the Board of Directors of the organization I created from scratch, ousted me.

It was a blow, but things happen for a reason. Today, I’m unleashed to do my work through my new organization, OMG, without any obstruction and **no one to stop me.**

Since I was fired, I’ve chosen not to look back. I want to move forward with my work, with happiness and spirit. **And I move forward carrying with me the many lessons I learned.**

Those 14 years were formative.

When I started, my hands would tremble when I confronted a target of my investigations. It took time, but I overcame my fears of confrontation by grounding myself in principle.

I learned about trust, loyalty, and leadership.

Most importantly, I learned the hard way the true depth of Michael Jordan’s quote on leadership: “Winning has a price. **And leadership has a price**.”

I’ve been sued for exposing the truth more times than I can count. And, get this, **yesterday, I was sued in federal court by the very organization I founded.**

In my opinion, their intent is to shut me down now that they no longer have any control over me.

And this lawsuit is going to cost me a fortune! That’s why I’m writing you today to **[ask for your support to my legal defense fund.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zlsutcd9upkcncjhvpir5r2ep7ntckfdv0ak7p78_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)**

My friends with the non-profit, Liberty Guard, have set up **[the fund to pay attorney costs](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zre0c8728dij71da2f6k0sgrutee1ib6nkm86cb0_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)** that will quickly pile up.

As I mentioned, this isn’t my first rodeo so I know that **the cost will exceed $500,000**.

Good attorneys aren’t cheap, and my pockets are not deep.

No one gets wealthy doing the work that I do. Trust me.

That’s where you come in. **[Will you chip in and help me defend myself](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zmfms54rp9m4i4vehv7bc81k34h9n3kondb0scb8_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)?**

When you do, I’ll be following up as the case progresses but I’ll also keep you informed of the great work I’m doing at OMG . . . and it’s exciting!

A fresh start, being forced to start over, I’ll admit is thrilling. And I’m starting armed with all of the lessons I’ve learned to avoid the pitfalls I’ve experienced.

Me and my teams are more efficient, we’re more productive, and our work hits like a sledgehammer.

But my work will be silenced if my former employer gets their way. Or the distractions of a court battle and its costs may become overwhelming.

Friend, **[I’m asking you to STAND UP FOR ME, so I can keep working](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zpocv1fi6284t72igh9ael7aav0uiveo4dcvo820_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)**. And I’ll commit to you that **I will NOT let you down**.

So please, **[make a donation to my legal defense fund through Liberty Guard](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z7knqh2jrh27j75tvrr3h4r9e6phb1ssmmmofk98_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)**. We have a long way to do to hit our goal, so please, donate as much as you can.

Friend, thank you for your direct or indirect support over the years. Your views, donations or simply talking about my work to friends and family has kept me going for 14 years . . . **and we cannot stop now!**

Respectfully,

James O’Keefe

P.S. I have 20 days to file my response to the lawsuit. I have to raise enough money to pay for a retainer and cover the legal work to defend against this lawsuit. This is unfortunately urgent so please, **[donate today](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z0kaivugbe5s9leksfpoivs4ipdoiaje1e5cieo8_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69or6c1h2bs)**.

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Biden isn’t wasting any time
body:
His ad claims it’s all about freedom, but his actions show the opposite.

| [ ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8ddpp7goq924kse8jckkc32eemvkhm0di2ba40o_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69o72c1h2bs)
---
Friend,

Five seconds.

That's how long it took President Biden to endorse abortion in his latest campaign ad. It's what he's running on. It's what he stands for: Taxpayer-funded abortion on demand up to birth.

His ad claims it's all about freedom, but his actions show the opposite.

Since coming into office, the Biden administration has worked to:
* Illegally force American taxpayers to fund abortion with their hard-earned dollars.
* Ignore violent threats and attacks on pro-life organizations and individuals.
* Trample on the rights of parents and healthcare providers.

Just six days after being sworn in, Biden signed an executive order to repeal the Global Protect Life policy--forcing American taxpayers to fund groups promoting abortion overseas. But he didn't stop there.

Within months, he rolled back President Trump's Protect Life Rule, funneling taxpayer dollars to abortion businesses through Title X. And he forced Americans to fund abortion in his Covid-19 relief package!

On top of all this, the Biden administration has been weaponizing the DOJ against the pro-life community. They put a target on anyone how dares to tell the truth that abortion takes the life of an innocent child--all while ignoring violence against peaceful pro-life organizations and individuals.

This is not only outrageous--it's dangerous.

But that hasn't stopped President Biden from going all-in on a radical pro-abortion agenda to fire up his base going into 2024. He is determined to rewrite all the rules--including the U.S. Constitution--to get his way.

That's why I'm emailing you today.

SBA Pro-Life America is fighting back against the Biden administration and its radical abortion agenda every single day. Our team is working around the clock to advance pro-life laws through direct lobbying and grassroots campaigns. And we are fighting to end abortion by electing national leaders who advocate for laws that save lives--with a special calling to promote pro-life women leaders.

**[But in order to do this critical work, we need your help.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg8e1bm21hnkjluli9cgpjhb7dreo3ichc6jtdr0_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69o72c1h2bs)**

Your gift today will allow us to expand our policy research efforts to further educate lawmakers across the country. And it will help us to grow our voter education initiative to ensure that pro-life Americans know the truth about where the Biden administration and other pro-abortion leaders stand on abortion.

You can make your gift right now using this secure link: **[https://secure.sbaprolife.org/stand-up-to-biden-harris](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ziq9h1u58q6ik8549kmd8av4s2svehre2vi9e8h8_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69o72c1h2bs)**

But please remember that time is of the essence. As President Biden ramps up his campaign efforts, we must be prepared to counter him every step of the way.

That's why your gift is urgently needed now.

Make your gift today to fight back against the Biden administration using this secure link: **[https://secure.sbaprolife.org/stand-up-to-biden-harris](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlcsgsjgksgjss6psehho9hef2gr46l5673up7mo_rp22sh2s8i66o77clj69o72c1h2bs)**

By doing so, you will help advance a culture of life that protects unborn children and their mothers from abortion.

Marjorie Dannenfelser

Despite his previous and most recent messaging on the campaign trail stating his [opposition to COVID-19 vaccines](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4e73fe37-48fe-4f58-9de7-59229e4e8935?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [child gender transitioning](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/20028082-9552-4ffa-9216-41a654cb5d03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the use of puberty blockers on children, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is willing to work with and take campaign cash from the individuals who are directly involved in lobbying federal legislators for the major pharmaceutical companies that are pushing the vaccines and childhood transitioning drugs.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/75398b5b-bc94-4c9b-ac6a-abccff454826?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The DeSantis Campaign is scheduled to hold a fundraiser on Friday, June 23, 2023. [The $1,000 per attendee (minimum) event will take place at 1155 F Street, Suite 1200 in Washington D.C, which is the office of Brownstein Hyatt Farber Schreck LLP](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a6b2183e-bea1-4e97-b4a2-c4cfba4a9f66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the [self-proclaimed largest lobbying firm by revenue in the nation's capital](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a12f6699-b0f2-4bc8-a2f7-7f90ced5818f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is the same law firm whose lawyers served as [lawyers](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bbc79fe2-b33e-45ec-b3ce-3a1fcae344b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Dominion Voting Systems.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b766072f-59f2-41af-a81f-0ef910ab702e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[A quick check of the company's website reveals that they proudly position themselves as a leader in Diversity, & Inclusion. ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c166e7d7-8f69-49dd-89ed-40c36cbb2a9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Notably named on the host committee for the DC fundraiser as part of the hose committee is [Marc Lampkin](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bfa697ad-6613-4b26-83eb-18e4cb7f94cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who has been registered as a lobbyist for COVID 19 vaccine manufacturer Moderna since February 2021. In addition to his work with Moderna, Lampkin has also been registered as a lobbyist for Pharmaceutical manufacturer [AbbVie](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1a010740-979f-4856-b3c2-2267b037eed3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the maker of the youth gender transitioning drug [Lupron](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2430b173-c56c-401a-b9b3-4a8acc2f6769?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) since 2014.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e5e7f6fd-4a6d-46d8-b3bb-10ac39281e66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Slater Bayliss is another name on the invitation for the DeSantis fundraiser host committee. ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8fc03eab-7293-43b3-9f7e-85d94eb3bdbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [ The Advocacy Partners](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/214a8aff-ddfb-42dc-9deb-ab111512cf5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an organization [Bayliss](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/42799710-dcd1-4623-add3-b71ff16b974d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) cofounded is currently [registered as a Florida lobbyist](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/08f56186-7447-40b0-a771-32c04237888b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). While a candidate being supported by a lobbying firm might not be a shock in itself, this particular firm's clients might be a surprise. Among the Advocacy Group's portfolio of clients, you will find ABInbev, the parent company of Anheuser Busch, which makes Bud Light. This is in stark contrast to a [Newsweek](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/449f8e1c-9d5a-4a90-a23d-0bee37c4cc74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) report showing a viral June campaign video of Ron DeSantis in which he said he refused to serve Bud Light.
In a staged campaign propaganda style video with Conservative commentator Benny Johnson, which Johnson tweeted from his [Twitter account on April 17, 2023](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e5b13dbc-7d8e-4c38-86e0-920d3d615903?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), DeSantis also said he would NEVER drink Bud Light ever again after the company created a pro-trans marketing campaign and made trans activist Dylan Mulvaney one of their key social media marketing influencers, a move which cost the company billions of dollars after they faced a massive consumer boycott.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z17a44icgtj8hct5ul71o3es5fed1cj69dsl9mto_rp22sh2s8i66o77clgm8ob1cph2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg4t8e5bluggs3gcv9pluil16h1ilgplnmedced0_rp22sh2s8i66o77clgm8ob1cph2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs3ruaiikal8j5pkdl97dgu4ninnh74duli1vb6o_rp22sh2s8i66o77clgm8ob1cph2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zufdtt6aaoc2c687ffe75dkanf4rjr6palrhu1e8_rp22sh2s8i66o77clgm8ob1cph2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

---
---

subject: BREAKING: Republicans pass censure resolution
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Folks,
Kevin McCarthy took up the resolution attacking me for holding Trump accountable.
After Trump threatened a primary challenge against any Republican who refused to vote for it, MAGA Republicans officially passed their resolution to censure me. Why? Because I upheld my oath of office and held Donald Trump accountable for his many abuses of power.
They will never silence me — not now and not ever — but I need your help to fight back. If you can, split an urgent $10 contribution to Seth Moulton and our campaign right now to help us respond to this unprecedented political attack. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
We face many pressing challenges as a country — affordable housing, access to health care, creating jobs, and so much more. Instead of addressing any of these challenges, Kevin McCarthy chose to take up this MAGA effort to distract from Donald Trump’s legal problems. They will never stop doing his bidding.
We've already known that the GOP is completely unhinged and beholden to Donald Trump.
With his call now to imprison me and primary any Republican who didn’t vote to censure me, Trump is telling the entire Republican Party that they must seek retribution against me politically and do whatever they can to prevent me from being elected to the Senate. This is not just a political stunt to rile up the MAGA base — it’s an attack on all accountability and constitutional oversight.
But make no mistake: If they thought this was going to deter me from holding Trump and his accomplices accountable or delivering real results for California and our nation, they thought wrong. I will not stop my fight to put truth and our democracy first — even if it means standing up to a twice-impeached ex-president and his lackeys.
With Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans ramping up their attacks against me, I’m going to need you by my side more than ever. Will you split a grassroots donation of $10 to help Seth Moulton and me stand up to the GOP’s attacks? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
MAGA Republicans may have voted to censure me, but I will always use my voice to hold them accountable. No matter what political retribution they throw at me next.
Let’s work together to push back against these attacks on our democracy.
Thank you,
— Adam

I’m Audrey – the new Email & SMS Manager here at the DLCC. With our end-of-quarter deadline quickly approaching, I wanted to reach out and ask you to But first, I want to give you a peek behind the curtain to explain why your support is so important: A big part of my job is tracking our results to keep the DLCC on pace to hit our weekly, monthly, and quarterly fundraising goals – and right now, we’re way off pace. subject: George Santos is not an anomaly.

body:
Vickie Paladino is an extreme MAGA candidate who flipped a New York City Council district from blue to red in 2021.
#
George Santos is not an anomaly.
He is the result of the MAGA wave that swept races up **and down** the ballot — including right here in NY-03.
**Case in point: Vickie Paladino** , an extreme MAGA candidate who flipped a New York City Council district from blue to red in 2021. She endorsed George Santos. She hugged and embraced him. And now she is up for re-election in a city council race this year. I have been making phone calls to encourage people to vote and showing up to rallies in Queens because winning this race is critical to ending the MAGA madness.
[**If you will give me just a minute, I will explain why the upcoming city council election will have such a big impact on our race here in NY-03. But first, if you want to make sure we have the resources to flip this seat blue, will you pitch in $5 today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/zm-email-20230623?amount=5&refcode=em20230623&refcode2=123_8507_30SPyS&akid=123%2E8507%2E30SPyS)

**Okay, back to Vickie.**
You see, a lot of people do not realize that **NY-03 is a swing district**. And if we can defeat MAGA extremists like Vickie in local races this year, it will show everyone that we have the potential and the momentum to flip NY-03 back to blue next year.
But if we are not engaged, and if we allow MAGA Republicans like Vickie to coast to re-election with ease, **it will be that much harder** to convince folks that we can flip this district and defeat Santos next November.

name: Congressman Brendan Boyle
subject: Here's what we're going to do...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Citizens for Boyle
body:
Friend, a year ago today, five unelected people overruled the will of the majority of the American people. Here's what we can do about it..... | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65274137/412905729/1060786640?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMjUyNTY2OC1kMzExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ooRaY2buQQZV-bLvfMrvpKauRIziTVi4E_gebb61cWo=)
---
| | Friend, one year ago tomorrow, five unelected justices overruled the will of the majority of Americans, taking away a woman's constitutional right to make her own healthcare decisions via the Dobbs ruling. **Because of the warped view of these five people, my daughter lives in an America where she has fewer rights than the one her mother was born into.** **As an American and as a father, it fills me with an anger that is hard to put into words.** **And as if to add insult to injury, over the year since the Dobbs ruling came down, we've seen the outrageous conflicts of interest Justices like Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito had been hiding laid bare before us...** **Free flights and vacations from billionaires.** **Tuition to expensive schools for relatives paid by wealthy benefactors.** **And ZERO accountability to the public.**
**This is unacceptable, and THIS is what we can do about it to clean up the Supreme Court...**
---
[STAND WITH US](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65274138/412905730/1060786640?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMjUyNTY2OC1kMzExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ooRaY2buQQZV-bLvfMrvpKauRIziTVi4E_gebb61cWo=)
---
| |
1. **Pass reforms in Congress** so that Supreme Court Justices are subject to the same kinds of ethics standards that almost every other federal employee has to abide by.

2. **Expand the court and eliminate lifetime appointments.** The process of appointing justices has been abused by partisan hacks like Mitch McConnell to subvert the will of the American people for long enough, and it's succeeded because we're working with an unnecessary limitation of nine justices who serve for life.
3. **Hold the United States Senate in 2024.** If Republicans retake the Senate, they WILL prevent President Biden from exercising his right to appoint any new justices, just as they did with Merrick Garland under President Obama. We can't give MAGA Republicans that veto power.

---
[STAND WITH US](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65274139/412905731/1060786640?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMjUyNTY2OC1kMzExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ooRaY2buQQZV-bLvfMrvpKauRIziTVi4E_gebb61cWo=)
---
**Make no mistake: if we fail to retake the House and hold the Senate, Republicans will use ANY levers of power they control to wreak havoc, including the half dozen unelected justices who've turned legislating from the bench into a perverted art form. And the American people are the ones who will suffer.**
This has to stop, and together, we can put an end to it and return our Supreme Court to being a place where justice is upheld, not where corruption and injustice reign supreme. I hope you'll stand with me as we move forward in this fight.

clean_body: Friend, a year ago today, five unelected people overruled the will of the majority of the American people. Here's what we can do about it..... | | | = | | Friend, one year ago tomorrow, five unelected justices overruled the will of the majority of Americans, taking away a woman's constitutional right to make her own healthcare decisions via the Dobbs ruling. Because of the warped view of these five people, my daughter lives in an America where she has fewer rights than the one her mother was born into. As an American and as a father, it fills me with an anger that is hard to put into words. And as if to add insult to injury, over the year since the Dobbs ruling came down, we've seen the outrageous conflicts of interest Justices like Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito had been hiding laid bare before us... Free flights and vacations from billionaires. Tuition to expensive schools for relatives paid by wealthy benefactors. And ZERO accountability to the public. This is unacceptable, and THIS is what we can do about it to clean up the Supreme Court... = | | 1. Pass reforms in Congress so that Supreme Court Justices are subject to the same kinds of ethics standards that almost every other federal employee has to abide by. 2. Expand the court and eliminate lifetime appointments. The process of appointing justices has been abused by partisan hacks like Mitch McConnell to subvert the will of the American people for long enough, and it's succeeded because we're working with an unnecessary limitation of nine justices who serve for life. 3. Hold the United States Senate in 2024. If Republicans retake the Senate, they WILL prevent President Biden from exercising his right to appoint any new justices, just as they did with Merrick Garland under President Obama. We can't give MAGA Republicans that veto power. = Make no mistake: if we fail to retake the House and hold the Senate, Republicans will use ANY levers of power they control to wreak havoc, including the half dozen unelected justices who've turned legislating from the bench into a perverted art form. And the American people are the ones who will suffer. This has to stop, and together, we can put an end to it and return our Supreme Court to being a place where justice is upheld, not where corruption and injustice reign supreme. I hope you'll stand with me as we move forward in this fight. Sincerely, Congressman Brendan Boyle | | ---|--- | | Paid for by Citizens for Boyle. Citizens for Boyle P.O. Friend, tomorrow is the one year anniversary of the Supreme Court's ruling to overturn Roe v. Wade. When that ruling came down, I called this the fight of our generation — and one year later, that hasn't changed.
In the last year alone, nearly half of all states have passed extreme abortion bans — _and many have banned it outright._ Millions of Americans no longer have the reproductive rights that they've counted on for decades. They're now forced to travel thousands of miles to access the care they need, which is simply impossible for many.

Peter -

3.14 Action, the largest organization dedicated to electing scientists, engineers and mathematicians to public office, just endorsed my campaign for Texas’ 32nd Congressional District. In past years, 3.14 helped to elect Democrats like Dr. Kim Schrier, astronaut Mark Kelly, weatherman Eric Sorensen, and many more to Congress. I’m honored to join the likes of these doctors and scientists as a 3.14 endorsed candidate.

**Here’s what Shaughnessy Naughton, president of 3.14 Action, had to say about our campaign:**

_“What Congress needs now more than ever is to have smart, driven leaders like Brian Williams in office. We founded 3.14 Action Fund on the principle that the government is better served by having elected officials with diverse backgrounds. There will be no better champion to serve the families of Texas in Congress than Brian Williams and that's why we need to send him to Washington. And why we are proud to endorse Brian Williams for Congress.”_

clean_body: There’s more than one way to support our cause and everybody plays a different role in the movement. | | | Peter — Across the country we’re seeing attacks on our freedom to move, to learn, to express ourselves, and ultimately to live. UWDA’s Squad leaders dropped a letter of demands to Republican Rep. Ken Calvert’s office in California 📩, hosted a rally to unapologetically declare that young people, immigrants, LGBTQ people are here to stay in Ohio 📣, and led a total of 10 actions across the country 🗣️. We understand that not everyone is in a position to organize events in their communities and join UWDA’s Squad for in-person actions — but there’s more than one way to support our cause and everybody plays a different role in the movement. | KELLY LOEFFLER CALLS ON ELECTION OFFICIALS TO IMPLEMENT EMERGENCY VOTING MACHINE FIX AHEAD OF 2024 June 16, 2023
Last week, Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler called for emergency action following [new reports](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zAa_GMoZubAFNorBY5T63U_Rzi3RM_iRQ0Y4Gr_-xEM3QjFU_oXk5iZx_oTntcx9z7A_AxIGSdIWM_tA9vq4kY_K4HHB1GVKbvZRPlxMXP_FlTjPQqdblt0GaTrFSbSigq_6jn5VV6zfXgkp_mV5R3Fd-Q2g2SuPAxguDwR5uYiwbkORxLjqUrjXCIf4vV97bHea3Ba3pOhWFA_P3RJqAHkc7iWLD5QlAfmJ-A6rvwjDfNdTY-qoW28EtutQOy-K&c=VBJ9xa7Pzqc_FxJK_3GvuSOOWyZcdALwbEGalsKoDSxNYVFsC6JqpQ==&ch=EFJlNNSB_OGyUHc3UO4Zdj5jE5F31JbEEWV6v5Rf-DvlN2jT8mojfA==) about a software vulnerability in Georgia's voting machines. The security threats, which were initially [discovered](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zAa_GMoZubAFNorBY5T63U_Rzi3RM_iRQ0Y4Gr_-xEM3QjFU_oXk5iZx_oTntcx9YSCis-vadCduNAdyPCDrs6pD1VeKDw7bHhQn72SM8_FrM418HnBOxU_Bl_fbPlU8XmA9tBcqhZtU9U2gxmYyJry0Ns0CU0x8ymV0J6vcqfKcGmtvkE6KDggfMv6vLjOQi9HgS3xc3BrdaWtl3RENNUmJ0iE_oc7TSLU2OgNfBe1CuTj3gcSryHJL2_7foII2G6liLH3Q4nVmUq7kBC9JT8qrWiadj-_H4pRDx7Mq3_x0h71T1J9SHg==&c=VBJ9xa7Pzqc_FxJK_3GvuSOOWyZcdALwbEGalsKoDSxNYVFsC6JqpQ==&ch=EFJlNNSB_OGyUHc3UO4Zdj5jE5F31JbEEWV6v5Rf-DvlN2jT8mojfA==) in a 2021 investigation, were later verified by the Department of Homeland Security, which urged states like Georgia to update the flawed voting software "as soon as possible." Though a security update is available, the Georgia Secretary of State's office announced last month that it was [refusing](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zAa_GMoZubAFNorBY5T63U_Rzi3RM_iRQ0Y4Gr_-xEM3QjFU_oXk5iZx_oTntcx9iNU_czxMlW0rRTZu5TWVDh8LiQvJWp91sFhgwO5W1AhBFNLoLJL81vyS-OVUdA4W4-C5UA1Kseq9154lRZqT16m-Uqb_G9VqWBhojAJJ3OeyZbH_1yw-B6gFbA9y--D2_0UA7KyvIH7nwVrZsYcebnNRq01SkgRdy4Gxz7tSdxZ9INT1mcHSequ4cog6YcLapQY41YHodnCa_JXxqHzRkQ==&c=VBJ9xa7Pzqc_FxJK_3GvuSOOWyZcdALwbEGalsKoDSxNYVFsC6JqpQ==&ch=EFJlNNSB_OGyUHc3UO4Zdj5jE5F31JbEEWV6v5Rf-DvlN2jT8mojfA==) to update the vulnerable election equipment until after the 2024 election.

| OTHER ELECTION NEWS
State Election Board: In related election news, the State Election Board met this week - where the Secretary of State's office [spoke at length](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zAa_GMoZubAFNorBY5T63U_Rzi3RM_iRQ0Y4Gr_-xEM3QjFU_oXk5oSCrO18rkAHrT9qJOzAIb5Tj14rs1bd2u4m6kbyN_qfi9BL2nlVje3lgi2m6aU-kpbKbDTkRyo_pg07k_pe4ZZE5mp6wJcgT54feHgr062yCOq9oCQy9Te_lcIsyx58atYUMfqYWy8AaJqC3qjXQXhe5QQmfNEF6-ChWCbuEDIdtAltZVgX7sNxWL3_fTrYSQ==&c=VBJ9xa7Pzqc_FxJK_3GvuSOOWyZcdALwbEGalsKoDSxNYVFsC6JqpQ==&ch=EFJlNNSB_OGyUHc3UO4Zdj5jE5F31JbEEWV6v5Rf-DvlN2jT8mojfA==) about why, despite two years' advance notice, it would not be updating Georgia's voting machines ahead of next year's presidential elections.
The State Election Board also ruled on a number of pending cases, [including](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zAa_GMoZubAFNorBY5T63U_Rzi3RM_iRQ0Y4Gr_-xEM3QjFU_oXk5oSCrO18rkAHjpyZuHvYXK3uBZq_oHK7Gi-o95FI5eBg5a5JNBb-0-TqFhN3hYLE7Y1RZCwNcC1Z8-YpHOtIvBT-wHlAIlZh86N69BX3f_QgeefQCcuL_GOY6-g_JUdgJbRO1j_qKFOZDUeQelUJsHvV_PYAxOZhXTrFF3atOv9yZjguZP-s01IIaVz30jx2BaZ2-bg98fmPc6H2GUIjDi0V1KbejJF5p81rbp_7SiqB&c=VBJ9xa7Pzqc_FxJK_3GvuSOOWyZcdALwbEGalsKoDSxNYVFsC6JqpQ==&ch=EFJlNNSB_OGyUHc3UO4Zdj5jE5F31JbEEWV6v5Rf-DvlN2jT8mojfA==) whether or not to take over the Fulton County Board of Elections - which they decided against.
Fulton County Board of Elections: Speaking of Fulton, the county has come under fire in recent weeks for refusing to approve the nomination of Jason Frazier, a Republican, to the local Board of Elections. This week, the County Commission [voted](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zAa_GMoZubAFNorBY5T63U_Rzi3RM_iRQ0Y4Gr_-xEM3QjFU_oXk5oSCrO18rkAHh5FcCUwYqog0xTPe6QwqM3kKOyqpdpDUfZQuY0OcMj7XW1pV3r8i3BhuxzUiOetw6I2jYv5LcrGOya-QaFS997kIHGGhPtt6dxDVovbTatyFMKilDfn48iOc9gxeDtPZlh6e1KysMUxCy_UwgLLWkZLzh3aVaJ8R-OJFgCglaXGHs43KeI3Lz1FJRTduIdwAAGdMs02aQvU=&c=VBJ9xa7Pzqc_FxJK_3GvuSOOWyZcdALwbEGalsKoDSxNYVFsC6JqpQ==&ch=EFJlNNSB_OGyUHc3UO4Zdj5jE5F31JbEEWV6v5Rf-DvlN2jT8mojfA==) for the second time to reject Frazier, citing his history of filing voter roll challenges.
As we [wrote](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zAa_GMoZubAFNorBY5T63U_Rzi3RM_iRQ0Y4Gr_-xEM3QjFU_oXk5oSCrO18rkAHphZ7hQMCzi3JobE9LwDMop2VnHP7Q3JuONOTik860ee1pKfiuybxPgmXGmjXqGKBtxAtgDIxptYA64BIrjx-z2_6vkKN4Rz4APbzbVvpngkVSKO-tTVb_VAmpgwNOLHK8VX11k1Ula8=&c=VBJ9xa7Pzqc_FxJK_3GvuSOOWyZcdALwbEGalsKoDSxNYVFsC6JqpQ==&ch=EFJlNNSB_OGyUHc3UO4Zdj5jE5F31JbEEWV6v5Rf-DvlN2jT8mojfA==) the first time Frazier was rejected: "Verifying voter rolls...is a LEGAL step that any Georgia citizen can take to reduce the potential for voter fraud. Fulton County has had more election issues than any other in our state's history - so it's no surprise they're blocking an Elections Board nominee who wants accurate voter rolls. Textbook example that the Left will do ANYTHING to dodge accountability."

They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes! Hello, In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert. Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd congressional district “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.” Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes! = In the end, though, the race went to a recount. Lauren Boebert won by just 546 votes, and Adam lost the closest race in the entire country. Because here’s what their “models” and “forecasts” didn’t factor in: Adam put in the work. He traveled 24,000 miles in our red pickup truck to every corner of the district. He met thousands and thousands of voters – and he listened. Now, my husband’s running again, and I’ll be honest: The first campaign was hard. But defeating Lauren Boebert is just too important to sit this out. Adam’s all-in to finish the job in 2024. I’m all-in. The government is at it again, folks. The overreach continues, and this time, they’re coming for your car! President Biden and the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) are moving full speed ahead with lofty goals in the name of climate activism. By slapping some of the strictest auto pollution limits on our cars, their hope is that [67% of new vehicles](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d258721b4ae6475bbf2f415d9aa280e3&_e=48WZqCgavM1LBMTTpRzIyKpZUrjOeJuWFC6HO98ypAT19HtBphSmkCX0PquaUs5NOFWch49UTh-QVe1QHJG4aTIrNvWOqW48LNCd_envDhmd89ZUZQ3cPD6iB892ACTA-Mfj-DgS2No2pkrLrwvh1wwe6BfxtbaCjTO1MtX53XIxarzrPev_OIpXbObA46rzED7JSWoLq_u5vbYDsMhyQSdfF-NMY75RV3QIwpcvCps2Ii0CL_2e2-kXT1Qd7CXF) are all-electric by 2032. We’re not stupid, Mr. President. Americans are aware that you’re on a mission to wipe out gas-powered vehicles altogether. There’s a reason why electric vehicle manufacturers absurdly say the new guidelines [don’t go far enough](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d258721b4ae6475bbf2f415d9aa280e3&_e=48WZqCgavM1LBMTTpRzIyIYfLIrD1WRP5SKorxeiKNYwz1pfkDP3d37Q89jJqQNrvHgsrz8gAYhYHtT9029igkiI3mTH0v-WMBlALfE7kdHIXE7FgFeeCqdzd7i4rscjM65w6jUJ3Q05-4WMDJqERWF4RJ9W2d2MUO-xndmUfZohXzFg_MnltEu8VkYi5fW60z6FxMSW2jfOhJrMSVYUtXulfb2NkiDcU_bjH-d02dkdlmUv2t54brb6chCfrlS32lWwaLoy3QFc83pmDjqDoMmwWhJWSZml04R0hpR_28kPo9WrifMGay50Ly1FbD2b5jdujaWYiwFOQdQFWdokRA%3D%3D). This is nothing but another Big Government power trip. The average American family can’t afford an electric vehicle; paying[ upwards of $60,000](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d258721b4ae6475bbf2f415d9aa280e3&_e=48WZqCgavM1LBMTTpRzIyCAZicIF6imhSfpzO2J28SFdRGyrx5fuY1je9XiYXebKVUyiXAkOGjji-jEeSpf6y8LtyuzObntJ4l7mIwaYzJAjqrwqIadub2hlAfzEmYzjoLimuQHx7P5a0u9ERHxcoLJBdv8ThWsgad4UDbFdvDkSQAACd9t3OWvKMSAymdd-hE_l1E1k-C4KsWykMXc0qu2n4-hf_KpAhboEfycotlxdjbU68WOOQFdr7vn08xQcuZJE27r-w7DhRRNDlGrBtQ%3D%3D) for a car is tomfoolery. Plus, the new regulations put the auto industry in a chokehold, making it difficult to do business. **These top-down mandates are unconstitutional.** Americans have a right to choose how they get from point A to point B, and I will continue to fight to get our government back to where it should be—working for us, not against us. Just recently, I received the “Champion of Limited Government” award from the Institute of [Legislative Analysis (ILA)](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d258721b4ae6475bbf2f415d9aa280e3&_e=48WZqCgavM1LBMTTpRzIyCa03qVOOYMjeMAcd7rFNNak3AIvQwyfjsPxNrPWV_n8ae5CqOp2s2Y-wMSWRkp-iEksmTRO-9C0cX0ogvlzJ55MALHp0eH0_d9I9CNtFOJWRu49qWEfUpjYofDdeGrn21P5hXwPZRmRjNck06og-kzBkqoPmYi8Bfr2cFfaicFFeywSi4C2N7dZVZ9K3z-TjGm__Ed4v-cnBWsI4lbhOuk%3D), an honor I’m truly proud of. Hard-working families shouldn’t be forced to pay more taxes to be more regulated by a bunch of Washington bureaucrats. I promise to continue to vote in a way that puts more power in _your hands_.
