body:
In the race to the bottom, United Airlines steps up to the plate to outdo Bud Light, Target, and Kohl's.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/130498fa786d/conservatives-causing-woke-companies-to-lose-billions?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Illinois Review eBlast Powered By
https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Conservatives Causing Woke Companies to Lose Billions in Value, While United Airlines Targets Church Leaders to Prove Employees' Religious Exemption Requests Were Legitimate, in Vax Mandate Lawsuit (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/conservatives-causing-woke-companies-to-lose-billions-in-value-while-united-airlines-targets-church-leaders-to-prove-employees-religious-exemption-requests-were-legitimate-in-vax-mandate-la.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

In the month of May (https://finbold.com/bud-light-target-and-north-face-stocks-lost-over-25-billion-from-their-value-since-may/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) alone, Target, Bud Light and North Face have lost over $25 billion in value since the companies started pushing their woke agendas – partnering with trangender activist Dylan Mulvaney in Bud Light’s case; pushing a pride-themed children’s clothing line in Target stores; and a “come out” pride ad directed at apparel company North Face’s customers.

But as financial data reveals, the strategies backfired in a major way, costing these companies billions of dollars in just a short period of time, as conservatives and people of faith across America push back, in ways never before seen.
(Source: NBC News)
But that’s not all. Recent court filings (https://www.breitbart.com/politics/2023/06/20/united-airlines-demands-access-to-employees-private-conversations-with-pastors-in-vaccine-mandate-lawsuit/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) reveal that Chicago-based United Airlines is demanding that employees who filed a religious exemption request in response to the company’s vaccine mandate, must hand over private communications with pastors and religious leaders, to prove their requests were legitimate, after the company mandated the COVID-19 vaccine last August for all 67,000 employees in the US.

In court documents, the airline alleges that,

“Plaintiffs hide behind the shield of clergy privilege in an attempt to protect against discovery of communications that might tend to undermine any claim of sincerity, or that may otherwise show their positions on vaccines are not supported by the religious teachings of their church and instead are motivated by political, secular or other reasons not protected by Title VII.”

The motion continues,

“Without access to the contemporaneous communications made by Plaintiffs regarding the specific areas over which are relevant to this suit, United is left with essentially nothing more to evaluate the sincerity of Plaintiffs’ religious beliefs than to take them at their word. The trust requirement runs contradictory to the adversarial nature of our justice system, which allows parties to verify and test the credibility of parties’ assertions.”

In September of 2021, eight employees filed a lawsuit against United Airlines on behalf of more than 2,000 employees, who were seeking a religious exemption from the company’s vaccine mandate.

If an employee’s religious exemption was accepted, they were placed on unpaid leave and stripped of medical benefits in what the company referred to as a “reasonable accommodation.”

Families – especially single parents and veterans, faced many challenges, when their medical benefits were stripped from them – with many needing ongoing health care treatments.

On May 30, 2023, attorneys representing United Airlines
requested (https://www.breitbart.com/politics/2023/06/20/united-airlines-demands-access-to-employees-private-conversations-with-pastors-in-vaccine-mandate-lawsuit/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that employees produce “all communications with any religious or spiritual advisors regarding vaccines or immunizations since the age of 18...”

The request also included “any communication you sent to or received from with any religious or spiritual leaders about the subject of United’s vaccine policy, the COVID-19 vaccine, your requests for accommodation, your placement on unpaid leave, or this Lawsuit itself from January 1, 2020 through time of trial.”

During a US Senate hearing in December of 2021, Republican
Sen. Ted Cruz (https://www.cruz.senate.gov/newsroom/press-releases/sen-cruz-grills-united-ceo-over-mistreatment-of-employees-seeking-religious-exemptions-to-the-companys-vaccine-mandate?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) didn’t mix words when confronting United CEO Scott Kirby, when he quoted from an opinion (https://www.ca5.uscourts.gov/opinions/pub/21/21-11159-CV0.pdf?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) written on December 13, 2021 by Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals Judge James Ho, who referred to the airlines’ “apparent disdain for people of faith,” writing,

“United’s mandate reflects an apathy, if not antipathy, for many of its employees’ concerns and a dearth of toleration for those expressing a diversity of thought. Through both its policy and its official statements to employees, United has demonstrated a ‘calloused approach to and apparent disdain for people of faith.’”

https://youtu.be/UF6YzXoC1TA?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=218c7f4adc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_23_02_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-218c7f4adc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Sen. Ted Cruz, R-TX, grills United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby on the company's vaccine mandate.

subject: My bowl cut
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BENNET FOR COLORADO
body:
Friend, what do you see in this picture?
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-crow-split?refcode=X_062323_JasonCrow_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-crow-split?refcode=X_062323_JasonCrow_act]
If we ignore the bowl cut, you’ll see a kid who has no clue what life has in store for him. All he wanted was to play with his Legos and run around in the backyard.
I grew up in a working-class family, so I know what the struggle is like for so many Americans. It wasn’t easy at times, but if there’s one thing my early life taught me, it’s to never give up.
I’ll be honest: There wasn’t always enough money growing up, so I started working at a young age. Paper routes, Arby’s, construction — and after high school I enlisted in the National Guard to help pay for college.
Then, right as I was preparing to graduate, 9/11 happened. It was a defining moment. Like so many others, I felt the call to serve my country. I went active duty and became an Army Ranger, putting my life on the line to defend our nation’s values.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-crow-split?refcode=X_062323_JasonCrow_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-crow-split?refcode=X_062323_JasonCrow_act]
I came back stateside after serving three tours in Iraq and Afghanistan. I wanted to continue giving back, so I offered pro-bono legal services to help veterans transition to civilian life.
Then Donald Trump became president. Extremists began threatening to strip away our health care. Immigrants were being demonized. Even our democracy felt fragile.
I felt that call to step up and serve again, so after long discussions, I decided to run for office. Our country needed a new generation of leadership — one that seeks to unite us, not divide.

name: Conservatives Give
subject: The relationship between God and man
body:
I hope you're having a good day. I'm writing with some exciting news.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5c17ae2689647af82dfe070bb1b6f9e&_e=c5bFBCWf0FFARlJynf8iYXVDR6m2gkJaxAXMUacUNhgzhMqs9Lxdn6LsTCNU9GHTfS1k2giH6jci23N9wzKd2x2DX-uym9t1sfAyXZgs9mdkdF1jdlQIq6lx-mXIP7caMAdIg9ihyBeNXTanWOR_ElWmlXJF774TxHYVgAm8UA-mRLq_BNtLPSP0kHnT7pyY6UMzzSThvBXeiSQv3MhgET4NdZyTppcqscr4LVa9McR4Vf86zC1JxGjyMNrn4_Oy6oGZFA5b4nMAuT2p83vnylwSkf-xkcgrkdFys8xitS7RgV_f1zjB3yX2YksYVVXRG4Rdfj_wJEDPeJ-QncRZFtf9HSqPB1fUaOe9aHSEL-qpRNBQ1I-2jc1-_VPbH70PLXp-aPocGXeC4Db17PlKAg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,

I hope you're having a good day. I'm writing with some exciting news.

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is available on DVD.

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5c17ae2689647af82dfe070bb1b6f9e&_e=c5bFBCWf0FFARlJynf8iYXVDR6m2gkJaxAXMUacUNhgzhMqs9Lxdn6LsTCNU9GHTfS1k2giH6jci23N9wzKd2x2DX-uym9t1sfAyXZgs9mdkdF1jdlQIq6lx-mXIP7caMAdIg9ihyBeNXTanWOR_ElWmlXJF774TxHYVgAm8UA-mRLq_BNtLPSP0kHnT7pyY6UMzzSThvBXeiSQv3MhgET4NdZyTppcqscr4LVa9McSEUBG5CfNeonKvwVA0uqCRtEDEFVwhQGcJkbEZ4UzvCmVGW1NFqslQ7ys53x9b-idGFd9JpSYdmB8fIAPu4-p0rA6SkCneTTdIrdxaTEIRAtWX_llvZzQl8Qr1BGgCAAcQSgQtgXLVOhSHaHFuLy2Wguskvann7CUKGRbBV0aJJw%3D%3D)In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the President of Hillsdale College, Dr. Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.
Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

These relationships are explored in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**For your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of Hillsdale College, you 'll receive the DVD as our thank you.**

To receive your Genesis DVD box set or to give it as a gift, please use the secure link here: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-genesis](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5c17ae2689647af82dfe070bb1b6f9e&_e=c5bFBCWf0FFARlJynf8iYXVDR6m2gkJaxAXMUacUNhgzhMqs9Lxdn6LsTCNU9GHTfS1k2giH6jci23N9wzKd2x2DX-uym9t1sfAyXZgs9mdkdF1jdlQIq6lx-mXIP7caMAdIg9ihyBeNXTanWOR_ElWmlXJF774TxHYVgAm8UA-mRLq_BNtLPSP0kHnT7pyY6UMzzSThvBXeiSQv3MhgET4NdZyTppcqscr4LVa9McTLT4KmcK9rluMeJ8l2oNNa-4FfTfB-kAF_EX7zcDvYltoRGMKmfuAguLNd5XRUViPZewEE975XkSvkY8fYd-bEWfVnNE5_32hXgOIJ9rHG9-LehNUGAMBumBjptOHdfbROrhMJ1Gdda_LtSiKaHQV7BBcl2qRZuO-LoCib81ZTXA%3D%3D)**

As you know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of state and federal government funding--even indirectly through student loans and grants. That's why your support is so crucial.

Your gift helps expand Hillsdale College's national educational outreach efforts to educate millions of Americans nationwide, including our nation's youth. Your gift will also help to:
* Increase the number of students taking free online courses, such as "Genesis."
* Expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty.
* Establish and guide classical K-12 schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.
* Promote the principles of American constitutionalism through social media and the radio.

Friend, please use the secure link above to make a $100 contribution in support of Hillsdale's educational outreach, and explore the beauty of the first book of the Bible with your new DVD set of **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives."**

Warm regards,

Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Vice President
National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

---
| | Friend, I didn't grow up in a fenceline community or a sacrifice zone. I didn't grow up feeling the same effects marginalized communities experience. **But even with my tremendous privilege, I still feel the effects of carbon pollution—**** _because we all do_****. ** Whether it's because of climate-fueled wildfires, heatwaves, or droughts, the urgency of the climate crisis is always top of mind. **That's why, last week, I chose to testify alongside fellow Evergreen staff and climate advocates on EPA's climate pollution standards for power plants. ** The Biden administration must strengthen these rules to meet our science-based climate goals—**[and there's still time to have your voice heard, too.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/EPA-clean-up-climate-pollution/?source=ema_2023_06_23_111rules_bump&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100clean&utm_source=email2023_06_23&t=3&akid=13437%2E53494%2EhZdGHK)**
---
[| | |
---|---|---](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4625?t=4&akid=13437%2E53494%2EhZdGHK "I just testified on EPA's power plant rules! You can still add your name")
[**TELL EPA: CLEAN UP CLIMATE POLLUTION**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/EPA-clean-up-climate-pollution/?source=ema_2023_06_23_111rules_bump&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100clean&utm_source=email2023_06_23&t=7&akid=13437%2E53494%2EhZdGHK)
---
To protect all of our communities, EPA has an obligation to strengthen these standards and propose further rules that create environmental safeguards and monitoring standards at smokestacks and CO2 storage sites, which directly impact fenceline communities.

While climate change represents the greatest challenge of our time, I'm in this line of work because I believe that there are clear, actionable solutions to build a better world for my generation and beyond. **[By calling on EPA to strengthen its rules on pollution from power plants, we can protect our communities from deadly climate pollution. ](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/EPA-clean-up-climate-pollution/?source=ema_2023_06_23_111rules_bump&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100clean&utm_source=email2023_06_23&t=8&akid=13437%2E53494%2EhZdGHK)** I hope you'll join me by taking action today.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105455/images/Gabe%20Amo%20Header_V6.png]
Dear Friend,

Tomorrow, June 24th, is the one-year anniversary of the United States Supreme Court’s decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization — a decision that overturned Roe v. Wade and 50 years of legal precedent that had affirmed the right to an abortion.

Tomorrow’s anniversary is a solemn day in our nation – a day that reminds us that liberty and justice for all is too often deferred, or in this case, denied to so many in states where abortion access has been severely restricted or banned altogether. Tomorrow is a reminder that we have a most sacred obligation to continue the fight to fulfill our nation’s highest ideals each and every day.
Abortion is reproductive healthcare. And access to healthcare is a human right that ought to be afforded to each and every person.

That is why, today, #TeamGabe is dedicating its social media platforms entirely to raising money for abortion funds in states around the country – including right here in the State of Rhode Island.
We hope you’ll consider donating to protect abortion access in one or some of the following states:

Protect Abortion Access in Rhode Island [https://whefri.org/take-action]
Protect Abortion Access in Missouri [https://mofund.org/donate]
Protect Abortion Access in Idaho [https://nwaafund.org/donate/]
Protect Abortion Access in North & South Carolina [https://www.carolinaabortionfund.org/donate]
Protect Abortion Access in Texas [https://fundtexaschoice.org/take-action/donate/]

Thank you for being in this fight with us to preserve and protect access to abortion for millions across the United States.

In solidarity,
Gabe Amo

| This was a big week. On Tuesday, we flipped a Mayoral seat held by Democrats for over a decade in the Village of Port Jefferson. What's even more incredible is that a write-in candidate won! Remember last year? Democrats' Chuck Schumer, Kathy Hochul, and Letitia James all lost in Suffolk's Legislative District 5. Even bigger was that a 40-year entrenched Assemblyman was defeated in our community by Republican newcomer Ed Flood.
Change is in the air, and with your help we will paint this seat a blazing RED!
I am out there in the community knocking on doors and meeting the voters, but your support is crucial. body:
Grab yourself some of our new 1776 4th of July gear!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

subject: Be part of the defiant movement...
body:
Mobilizing patriots & supporting local

| | | |
---
**Driving Liberty Across Texas**
**We are building bridges with the community** and **supporting local businesses** through a uniquely engaging initiative called Project Defiant... and we're inviting you to be part of it!

More on that later...

This initiative will feature an **eye-catching truck** , appropriately christened "The Defiant," **wrapped in patriotic graphics** that will **symbolize our movement** and be a **moving billboard for local businesses**.
What makes this truck so unique? This truck will be more than just a vehicle; it will be a **testament to American resilience** and **community spirit**. People will be captivated by its design, and it will naturally attract attention on and off social media.
**Here's where the magic happens...**
**Local businesses can sponsor this truck**. It will prominently **display their company logo** on the tailgate for a minimum of one year. But that's not all. These sponsors will also receive **social media exposure** to an audience of over 100k and have the opportunity to **host an event at their location** , _driving foot traffic_ and _attention_ to their business.

Imagine the synergy - our campaign for liberty goes hand in hand with supporting the backbone of our community, the local businesses.

This eye-catching truck will also be proudly driven in patriot trains and parades, spreading our message far and wide.

**Here are two ways you can participate:**
1. If you own a business, become a sponsor!
2. If you don't own a business, sponsor your favorite local business!

**With your support, we can make Project Defiant a rolling beacon of freedom, liberty, and patriotism that goes hand in hand with supporting the local businesses that keep Texas great.**
Afterall... nothing is more defiant than ditching "Big Business" to support local.
I invite you to rally behind our movement and either become an official sponsor or become a sponsor on behalf of your favorite local business! Let's unite under shared principles and drive growth with this powerful symbol. By building bridges within our community and celebrating our patriotic spirit, we can work toward a Texas that stands firm on life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

**Click or tap below to learn more or become a sponsor today!

Hello — **Tomorrow is the one-year anniversary of the Supreme Court overturning _Roe v. Wade_ — a ruling that stripped away the fundamental right to legal, safe abortions for millions of women like me. Since then, thirteen right-wing state legislatures have banned abortion as Republicans march us towards a national abortion ban.** It serves as a stark reminder that my opponent, Brian Fitzpatrick, **TWICE** voted against the Women's Health Protection Act (both before AND after the Dobbs decision). But we didn’t sit on our hands while Brian and his GOP cronies eviscerated our rights. We organized. We marched. We held huge rallies right here in PA-01 and all over the country. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65283088/412939149/-1928036833?refcode=fl_em_fr_20230623dobbsplit_ae_act_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZjhkODZiMi1lMzExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VTAMR-719suRh_Y4prefXRalUgWIOKridbOvEAg8B8k=)

body:
Our senior senator Bob Casey is facing a tough reelection fight in 2024.
#
Hi Derek,
All eyes are gonna be on PA to see what happens in 2024 — and we've got to be ready for anything. And the truth is, my friend Bob Casey's Senate race is gonna be a real toss-up.
**CNN + Roll Call both rated Pennsylvania's 2024 Senate race a battleground** — and there isn't even an official GOP challenger yet. That means our slim Democratic majority in the Senate depends on this team coming together to re-elect Bob Casey to keep fighting for PA families. 💪
**[Derek, if you can, will you split a contribution between our campaign and Bob Casey's today so they can build a strong campaign + fight back against the GOP's million$?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230623-1?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com-em20230623-1-8423&refcode2=8423_434096_q7iLQ6&akid=8423%2E434096%2Eq7iLQ6)**

**[It's up to us to fight back and keep two Democrats representing PA in the Senate. subject: Biden isn’t wasting any time
body:
His ad claims it's all about freedom, but his actions show the opposite.

| [ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c95efda0cfc74dc8bd4e5f3940eb9abc&_e=RJ9cSC93blqnyzffNAZBMJsHXEzT6ALO2OoSXel54E1DQo0G61sf4u3unjBF5059EBFpXRL_mf0mQjPwwTbGBMkTrI7A0Dt4J8y237E1Ix4eRd4u7uk78p-5wYwqNMipR0OUlM510qZJ6JsOPF9QQ8qHC7t4u-92_C__TOu4-Ygst-IEP79rLnfpfLh2rlqdVTmCIG_YQw-xncEJstyic_NHOnZpaZ57NSQmXhX4kae0w1mj3ruIOCqab2VOYMq06pjDO9M2lLADCNdf3KxscUsFiePpnbIn2sCymwyZ1-dHJQ0hKKAbKvyaf187k_mbrNWWiEdh32imtmSReDKljzL0Vvjy1FWSMPXkeQ6KloGEavoxs8ZNEk8VMtiSXBPGTVzPW1I2YeLxHDoVGpogZZ_WOgdzeI2ojBckiMg2PFs%3D)
---
Friend,

Five seconds.

That's how long it took President Biden to endorse abortion in his latest campaign ad. It's what he's running on. It's what he stands for: Taxpayer-funded abortion on demand up to birth.

His ad claims it's all about freedom, but his actions show the opposite.

Since coming into office, the Biden administration has worked to:
* Illegally force American taxpayers to fund abortion with their hard-earned dollars.
* Ignore violent threats and attacks on pro-life organizations and individuals.
* Trample on the rights of parents and healthcare providers.

Just six days after being sworn in, Biden signed an executive order to repeal the Global Protect Life policy--forcing American taxpayers to fund groups promoting abortion overseas. But he didn't stop there.

Within months, he rolled back President Trump's Protect Life Rule, funneling taxpayer dollars to abortion businesses through Title X. And he forced Americans to fund abortion in his Covid-19 relief package!

On top of all this, the Biden administration has been weaponizing the DOJ against the pro-life community. They put a target on anyone how dares to tell the truth that abortion takes the life of an innocent child--all while ignoring violence against peaceful pro-life organizations and individuals.

This is not only outrageous--it's dangerous.

But that hasn't stopped President Biden from going all-in on a radical pro-abortion agenda to fire up his base going into 2024. He is determined to rewrite all the rules--including the U.S. Constitution--to get his way.

That's why I'm emailing you today.

SBA Pro-Life America is fighting back against the Biden administration and its radical abortion agenda every single day. Peter,

Tomorrow, exactly one year will have passed since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and stripped millions of American women of the right to make their own healthcare decisions.

The ruling in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ was an attack on freedom of choice in this country. It was an unprecedented elimination of a previously guaranteed constitutional right. The decision eroded public trust in the Supreme Court to historic lows -- roughly one-quarter of the American public say they have confidence in our nation’s highest court.

Today, the extreme-right is taking advantage of this ruling to restrict abortion rights in numerous states. In fact, people began flocking to Illinois – including IL-17 – for reproductive care after it was outlawed in several surrounding states following the _Dobbs_ ruling.

**Our work to restore reproductive rights in this country is underway. I'm under no illusion that our fight to restore reproductive rights will be easy, but it's one I'll never give up on. We need to codify _Roe v. Wade_ , and until then, we need to block any and all attempts at a national abortion ban.**

body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|

| | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bde01ed4f4d6454fad08f548f76b8791&_e=AIejc1-GvMRbo_I_jNN7S4QpwkDxzpVddpKgek8MXQ_BWbt6Latz2SC-rtY_ho_dPCGQ_Y4RW__0jSuuf7BWbuzHnjQTRjAnyhIdI75mQVwrXJbrbHACdI9w3jc_0PJeMQQvJK9OE73qd1w98KU68D7KyJ0p_4lXyYFKapPTmq1KBEewU6v-fIrqRw5HJeP2NfZkiKGz2T2gOJBK3CKLp8u_HIRI7k44yRmQEcAgprpYwN8ohTSxRyZ-hXBgWaw1cFFPreEoo--ZueNfdVM_neQVus5D3nUqAWmauZBcu7UtNb2Gs8W4FqTyWiv1T8dezZW5HX6x7tpE5hjMyU4ZeM8jxlK1KqSLMi5DCTcFZoNPSo7ut5aaeuFty6YSdOIrLa3Hyp-iu8Zgl3a9gLX3zMPaR2mj_WtZ4fNsn20788M%3D)

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bde01ed4f4d6454fad08f548f76b8791&_e=AIejc1-GvMRbo_I_jNN7S4QpwkDxzpVddpKgek8MXQ_BWbt6Latz2SC-rtY_ho_dPCGQ_Y4RW__0jSuuf7BWbuzHnjQTRjAnyhIdI75mQVwrXJbrbHACdI9w3jc_0PJeMQQvJK9OE73qd1w98KU68D7KyJ0p_4lXyYFKapPTmq1KBEewU6v-fIrqRw5HJeP2NfZkiKGz2T2gOJBK3CKLp8u_HIRI7k44yRmQEcAgprpYwN8ohTSxRyZ-hXBgWaw1cFFPreEoo--ZueNfdVM_nSOjA2esSoBXdtyChGGvYiaAnUMEF4EQ6st2wF206smJf8xOto5gh8_cwT-RI7DxmA94MvJ6-DwmICmGPcthsfehK_X6DjOa9qItKTEdxunVqswPyhjUuxnD9A59u82jXO8a_dJnd1qo0OOw5lOJAhQ%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bde01ed4f4d6454fad08f548f76b8791&_e=AIejc1-GvMRbo_I_jNN7S4QpwkDxzpVddpKgek8MXQ_BWbt6Latz2SC-rtY_ho_dPCGQ_Y4RW__0jSuuf7BWbuzHnjQTRjAnyhIdI75mQVwrXJbrbHACdI9w3jc_0PJeMQQvJK9OE73qd1w98KU68D7KyJ0p_4lXyYFKapPTmq1KBEewU6v-fIrqRw5HJeP2NfZkiKGz2T2gOJBK3CKLp8u_HIRI7k44yRmQEcAgprpYwN8ohTSxRyZ-hXBgWaw1cFFPreEoo--ZueNfdVM_ncGClTlCor0zx4QrgVBD2xdaaS2dikjLjO17G4dj6he8xm8hsOkOekh32ck_B-THxoAxOK4bLNMhlVeAwsEpX3Y_oC1HUTZ28hZlrDAZQyeVfz2_tpFTSNrUhP2Md26pKXoqPODNUvMwAL80U40ZqK8%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bde01ed4f4d6454fad08f548f76b8791&_e=AIejc1-GvMRbo_I_jNN7S4QpwkDxzpVddpKgek8MXQ_BWbt6Latz2SC-rtY_ho_dPCGQ_Y4RW__0jSuuf7BWbuzHnjQTRjAnyhIdI75mQVwrXJbrbHACdI9w3jc_0PJeMQQvJK9OE73qd1w98KU68D7KyJ0p_4lXyYFKapPTmq1KBEewU6v-fIrqRw5HJeP2NfZkiKGz2T2gOJBK3CKLp8u_HIRI7k44yRmQEcAgprpYwN8ohTSxRyZ-hXBgWaw1cFFPreEoo--ZueNfdVM_nVmnAVkfFW0YYu2cqgrQ58NVYAAKSSn_f72zRjZd_dHB6ArAnf6N2Es3n5gPHZfmk1RX1INvWrUr-as3Tx3ge46Wu45YN2Ci015J79JiX8wiZ5rN9XqKYBFVWRqXPzS443Cawk0fUGQ4MicRPuY4dZ8%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Friend,

Five seconds.

That's how long it took President Biden to endorse abortion in his latest campaign ad. It's what he's running on. It's what he stands for: Taxpayer-funded abortion on demand up to birth.

His ad claims it's all about freedom, but his actions show the opposite.

Since coming into office, the Biden administration has worked to:
* Illegally force American taxpayers to fund abortion with their hard-earned dollars.
* Ignore violent threats and attacks on pro-life organizations and individuals.
* Trample on the rights of parents and healthcare providers.

Just six days after being sworn in, Biden signed an executive order to repeal the Global Protect Life policy--forcing American taxpayers to fund groups promoting abortion overseas. But he didn't stop there.

Within months, he rolled back President Trump's Protect Life Rule, funneling taxpayer dollars to abortion businesses through Title X. And he forced Americans to fund abortion in his Covid-19 relief package!

On top of all this, the Biden administration has been weaponizing the DOJ against the pro-life community. They put a target on anyone how dares to tell the truth that abortion takes the life of an innocent child--all while ignoring violence against peaceful pro-life organizations and individuals.

This is not only outrageous--it's dangerous.

But that hasn't stopped President Biden from going all-in on a radical pro-abortion agenda to fire up his base going into 2024. He is determined to rewrite all the rules--including the U.S. Constitution--to get his way.

That's why I'm emailing you today.

SBA Pro-Life America is fighting back against the Biden administration and its radical abortion agenda every single day. Our team is working around the clock to advance pro-life laws through direct lobbying and grassroots campaigns. Friends - in the early days of Donald Trump’s campaign, I remember feeling the pressure and fear that many others did in my community. His rhetoric was inflammatory and bigoted, and he targeted many people while stoking the flames of a radical base primed with hatred. It wasn’t just the LGBTQ+ community - it was all communities outside of the radical right and their idea of what America “should be.” At his behest, they defined America as “great” as long as it didn’t include us and our rights. Women’s rights. Working people’s rights. The rights of immigrants and those seeking a better life in our nation. And so, I moved from a military service career to a civil service life. I attended and spoke at the Women’s March in 2018. I worked within my community to advance the rights of LGBTQ+ individuals and pushed back against the Trump administration’s discriminatory policies towards those of us in the military. I worked with vaccination clinics during the height of the Covid pandemic to see that people were protected against an illness that ravaged our country. And now, I am working towards ensuring that as a hopeful Congressional Representative, people across all communities are seen, and heard and that I am fighting for them. Friends, I can’t do this alone. As a campaign funded solely on grassroots support, I need you to help me achieve this goal for all of us. **[Can you chip in $50 today and help carry this campaign to victory for Maryland and for all communities?](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5220?id=41683.577.1.031bff4224637a6d7efcd000fbd345ce)**

Derek, I’m so proud to share this news with you:

Derek, I’m so proud to share this news with you:

**I-95 is reopened!**

It’s been less than two weeks since the overpass on I-95 collapsed, shutting down traffic on a critical stretch of highway on the East Coast.

Experts said it would take months to get I-95 reopened.

But because of the hard work of our outstanding tradesmen and women and our all hands on deck approach, we defied the odds and the road is officially reopened.

For too long, people have become accustomed to a government that doesn’t have a can-do attitude. Too many believe we can’t get big things done.

We changed that, Derek. We worked around the clock to rebuild I-95 safely and ahead of schedule. That’s what you should expect from your elected leaders every day.

**Thank you to everyone who made this massive undertaking possible, from the Philadelphia Building Trades, to the folks who dropped off food for our workers, to our government partners, and to our state and local first responders who responded to this emergency and kept Pennsylvanians safe throughout. We couldn’t have done this without you.**

See you out on the road!

Josh Shapiro

Casey DeSantis
First Lady of Florida

**RON DESANTIS GOT RESULTS FOR FLORIDA**
---
| | | **K-12 Education**

Parents' rights have been increasingly under assault around the nation, but in Florida, we stand up for the rights of parents and the fundamental role they play in the education of their children.
* School choice is available for all Floridians by eliminating enrollment caps and income requirements while still prioritizing lower-income families and expanding scholarships for students with special needs.

* Florida is now the first state in the nation to have school choice fully integrated in the public K-12 funding process.

* Florida is ranked #1 in education freedom, #1 in parental empowerment, #1 in state spending on private school choice, and #1 in school choice enrollment.

* Florida eliminated Critical Race Theory in its K-12 schools.

* In 2021 Florida created annual increases in scholarships for students with special needs and we provided $750 for transportation costs to the chosen school.

* Florida has established robust civics education requirements so that students learn about the constitution and what it means to be an American.

**Higher Education Reform**

Academia, writ large, across the country, has lost its way. In Florida, we're changing that with a series of reforms:
* Ending tenure by instating regular performance reviews.

* Dismantling the monopolistic style of higher ed accreditation agencies.

* Resetting the focus of higher ed towards preparing students to be contributing members of society, rather than imposing political ideology.

* Ensuring students and staff are evaluated based on merit and eliminating so-called D.E.I. programs, which are effectively programs based in discrimination, exclusion, and indoctrination.

**China**

Ron DeSantis has taken action to stand against the United States' greatest geopolitical threat -- the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). He signed legislation that:
* Prevents Chinese entities or affiliates from buying farmland in Florida or land near our military bases.

* Stops sensitive data from being stored on servers that might be owned by entities affiliated with the CCP.

* Prohibits the Chinese influence that we rooted out of higher education from working its way into our primary and secondary education institutions, including a prohibition on Confucious institutes.

* Blocks access to dangerous applications, such as TikTok, on government servers and devices.

**Protecting Life **
* The Heartbeat Protection Act protects the most vulnerable: babies in the womb whose hearts have already begun to beat.

**Defending 2nd Amendment Rights **
* Enacted constitutional carry that allows Floridians to carry concealed weapons without a government-issued permission slip.

**Law and Order**

Other states endanger their citizens by making it easier to put criminals back on the street. Here in Florida, we support and enact policies to protect our communities and keep our people safe. Governor DeSantis signed reforms that:
* Strengthen pre-trial detention and pushed back against woke "bail reform" efforts

* Increasing sentences for drug traffickers that target children with dangerous fentanyl.

* Subjected child rapists to the death penalty while simultaneously reforming death penalty statutes to ensure justice.

* Gov. DeSantis is also the only elected official in America to remove a "progressive" Soros-funded district attorney from office.

**Immigration**

The Biden Border Crisis has wreaked havoc across the United States and has put Americans in danger. But Governor DeSantis did not stand idly by while the federal government abandoned its lawful duties to protect our country, instead he:
* Mandated immigration status verification through E-Verify for public and private employers.

* Made knowingly transporting illegal immigrant minors a felony.

* Made using a fake ID to gain employment a felony.

* Required hospitals to report healthcare costs for illegal aliens.

* Gave Florida more money to send more illegal immigrants to more "sanctuary" jurisdictions such as Martha's Vineyard.

**Prescription Drugs**

Pharmacy benefit managers and Big Pharma have managed to escape the public eye and work in the shadows for far too long. Ron DeSantis signed a bill that takes the reins back from these healthcare monopolies while empowering consumers.
* With the legislation passed this session, drug companies must disclose wholesale drug price increases of 15% or more.

* Florida is also prohibiting pharmacy benefit managers from mandating mail orders.

**Tax Cuts**

Florida's economy has consistently outpaced the nation, but we are still fighting against inflationary policies imposed on us by the Biden administration. In Florida, we supported our residents and helped them afford the goods that they need.
* We lowered tolls across the state.

* We created a permanent tax exemption on diapers, wipes, baby clothes, cribs, strollers, and much more.

* We reduced taxes by nearly $5 billion - a Florida record.

**Legal Reform and Housing**

As Florida's population booms, we have provided record support for Florida's workforce to get quality housing and live the American Dream.
* The Live Local Act dedicates more than half a billion dollars to incentivize and jumpstart new construction.

* The Hometown Heroes Program makes sure police officers, firefighters, teachers, and other community leaders can afford to live in or near the communities they serve.

**Environmental, social, and corporate governance & Central Bank Digital Currency **

Ron DeSantis refuses to let elites circumvent the ballot box to implement a radical ideological agenda through financial sleight of hand.
* Governor DeSantis signed legislation that prohibits the financial sector from considering so-called "Social Credit Scores" in banking and lending practices that aim to prevent Floridians from obtaining loans, lines of credit, and bank accounts.

* And Governor DeSantis is on the record: NO to CBDCs or Federally-controlled digital dollar. Any proposal will be dead on arrival.

**Let Kids Be Kids **

There is a disturbing trend in our society to try to sexualize young people. That is not the way you look out for our children. You protect children--and Governor DeSantis has, by signing landmark legislation that:
* Prohibits sex reassignment surgeries and prescriptions for children under 18.

* Bans children from attending drag shows.

* Protects students from having to "declare" their pronouns in school and ensures that students are not forced to use pronouns that are not based on a student's biological sex.

* Expands parents' rights in the education of their children by prohibiting classroom instruction on sexual orientation and gender identity in Pre-K through 8th grade.

* Protects young women from being forced to use bathrooms and locker rooms alongside biological males who have decided that they can invade women's spaces.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. **__** _Republican Policies Are Creating a State that Works for Less_ Compared to workers nationally, Hoosiers workers are not getting a fair deal. Republican policies have made Indiana one of the [very worst states to find a job](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65285981/412949565/893950892?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjZiNzg3YS1lOTExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v7aLRe_LoNT70KLr2jRshese6fzBfSWR4EW0Ljw5cFM=&emci=48f7af74-c611-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=526b787a-e911-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) in the entire country, and [new data shows](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65285984/412949569/-4395510?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjZiNzg3YS1lOTExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v7aLRe_LoNT70KLr2jRshese6fzBfSWR4EW0Ljw5cFM=&emci=48f7af74-c611-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=526b787a-e911-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) that Hoosiers are making over $11,300 less than the average worker nationwide. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65285987/412949572/-1944881433?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjZiNzg3YS1lOTExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v7aLRe_LoNT70KLr2jRshese6fzBfSWR4EW0Ljw5cFM=&emci=48f7af74-c611-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=526b787a-e911-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) [Read INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65285990/412949576/-1944881433?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjZiNzg3YS1lOTExLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v7aLRe_LoNT70KLr2jRshese6fzBfSWR4EW0Ljw5cFM=&emci=48f7af74-c611-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=526b787a-e911-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) This means that the average Hoosier would have to work through March 10 of next year just to make what the average American worker makes in 2023. 91 of 92 counties in the state make less than the national average; only workers in Marion County make more. body:
Here’s the truth:
#

Hey there,
We know we’ve sent you a lot of messages ahead of the FEC deadline at the end of the month. No doubt about it. So we wanted to take a second to explain why your support is so important to what we’re trying to accomplish.
Here’s the truth: **if we lose our Democratic majority in the Senate, Mitch McConnell and the GOP will immediately start implementing a right-wing extremist agenda.**
We’re talking about a _national abortion ban._
We’re talking about _attacks on our immigrant communities._
We’re talking about _attacks on our LGBTQ communities._
We’re talking about an environment policy that leaves our country _unprepared for the devastating impacts of climate change._
We’re talking about _tax breaks for the massive corporations and the ultra-wealthy._
And we’re even talking about _attacks on our free and fair elections_ — the cornerstone of our democracy.
Alex is working hard to support his colleagues in tough races across the country — but he can’t do it alone. No one can.
**The ONLY way we’re going to maintain our majority in the Senate and keep making progress for California and the country is if folks like you step up and get involved.**
With our FEC deadline just one week away, we’re asking you to chip in today:

body:
I grew up in Squirrel Hill, a small neighborhood of Pittsburgh. I learned early on what it meant to be a fighter, to stand up for others when they couldn't stand up for themselves.

Team,

I grew up in Squirrel Hill, a small neighborhood of Pittsburgh. I learned early on what it meant to be a fighter, to stand up for others when they couldn't stand up for themselves.

When I was a high school freshman, my brother Anthony was diagnosed with muscular dystrophy. Insurance companies called it a pre-existing condition, and refused him coverage. The bills piled up, even after he died at the age of 20.

After returning from Vietnam, my dad turned to drugs and ended up in jail, leaving my mother and me to keep our family business going. I took any job I could get to make ends meet and put myself through college.

But my story isn’t unique. We’ve all had our struggles. From losing my brother, to seeing my dad behind bars due to addiction, I’ve seen how our current political and justice systems fail so many people. I understand the challenges many families face because I’ve lived them too. [**As your next Attorney General, I’ll fight like hell for folks like you – just like I fought for Anthony and my dad. body:
This time we’re looking at you, Justice Samuel Alito. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65304680/412997758/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ14W_SUP_E_20230623_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjYwZTdjNi0wZjEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jICqrzyE50ANUVMCy1DaSN2gC99XKtibGFQglnJC8b4=&emci=fc5fe7c6-0f12-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=0260e7c6-0f12-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=9027908)
---
Since sending you the below note about my Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act just last week, _two_ (2) more revelations regarding the Supreme Court’s egregious lack of ethical standards have surfaced.
* ProPublica has reported that Justice Alito took a luxury fishing trip to Alaska with GOP megadonor and hedge fund manager Paul Singer — who later had cases before the Supreme Court after their rendezvous.
* CNN just reported that Justice Alito also enjoyed a trip to Rome last year funded by a conservative activist group that has filed briefs before the court in recent years — including the case that overturned Roe v. Wade.

This pile-on of conflicts of interests from Supreme Court Justices — a fishing trip here, a yacht vacation there — would be laughable if it wasn’t so damn infuriating. [**I’m fighting with everything I’ve got to make the Supreme Court finally follow a binding Code of Conduct. Read about my plan below — and if you’re able, please chip in $15 or anything you can to power this fight and help get this done.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65304681/412997759/63430846?amount=15&refcode=EMZ14W_SUP_E_20230623_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjYwZTdjNi0wZjEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jICqrzyE50ANUVMCy1DaSN2gC99XKtibGFQglnJC8b4=) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth \-----Forwarded message----- **From:** Elizabeth Warren (info@elizabethwarren.com)
**Date:** Wed, June 14, 2023
**Subject:** Yes, Justice Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you There are only nine federal judges who aren’t bound by an enforceable code of conduct. They all serve on the Supreme Court. And we’ve all seen the consequences. Justices ruling on cases with personal and financial conflicts of interests. Refusing to recuse themselves from cases that could impact their own family members. Speaking at events and attending all-expenses-paid trips funded by groups doing business before the Court. Look: the honor system just isn’t cutting it. **We need a binding, enforceable code of conduct to ensure that members of the nation’s highest court are held to the highest standard of ethics.** [**So last week, Representative Pramila Jayapal and I reintroduced our Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act to make it happen. Congress needs to see that the American people are demanding action — will you add your name as a grassroots cosponsor today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65304682/412997760/-675453559?refcode=EMZ14W_SUP_E_20230623_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjYwZTdjNi0wZjEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jICqrzyE50ANUVMCy1DaSN2gC99XKtibGFQglnJC8b4=&emci=fc5fe7c6-0f12-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=0260e7c6-0f12-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=9027908) Here’s some of what this sweeping package of reforms would accomplish:
* Make the Supreme Court follow a binding Code of Conduct
* Ban federal judges from owning individual stocks
* Tighten restrictions on gifts and privately funded travel (yes, Justice Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you)
* Overhaul the broken recusal process (once again looking at you, Justice Thomas)
* Create new tools to hold judges accountable for ethical misconduct

And here’s one reason why rooting corruption out of the judiciary is so powerfully important: the public’s trust in our judicial system is plummeting. When someone has their day in court, they shouldn’t have to wonder whether the judge in front of them is making decisions based on their financial interests rather than the rule of law. But that’s exactly what our current setup enables. And it’s crying out for reform. **I’ll keep fighting to clean house and restore public confidence in the courts by passing the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act. But I can’t do it alone.** [**Please add your name to say you support tackling corruption in our federal judiciary — and let’s fight side by side to get this done.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65304683/412997761/-675453559?refcode=EMZ14W_SUP_E_20230623_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjYwZTdjNi0wZjEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jICqrzyE50ANUVMCy1DaSN2gC99XKtibGFQglnJC8b4=&emci=fc5fe7c6-0f12-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=0260e7c6-0f12-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=9027908) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | [**DONATE NOW**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65304684/412997762/63430846?refcode=EMZ14W_SUP_E_20230623_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjYwZTdjNi0wZjEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jICqrzyE50ANUVMCy1DaSN2gC99XKtibGFQglnJC8b4=)

This pile-on of conflicts of interests from Supreme Court Justices — a fishing trip here, a yacht vacation there — would be laughable if it wasn’t so damn infuriating. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth \-----Forwarded message----- From: Elizabeth Warren (info@elizabethwarren.com) Date: Wed, June 14, 2023 Subject: Yes, Justice Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you There are only nine federal judges who aren’t bound by an enforceable code of conduct. They all serve on the Supreme Court. And we’ve all seen the consequences. Justices ruling on cases with personal and financial conflicts of interests. Refusing to recuse themselves from cases that could impact their own family members. Speaking at events and attending all-expenses-paid trips funded by groups doing business before the Court. Look: the honor system just isn’t cutting it. We need a binding, enforceable code of conduct to ensure that members of the nation’s highest court are held to the highest standard of ethics. Here’s some of what this sweeping package of reforms would accomplish: Make the Supreme Court follow a binding Code of Conduct Ban federal judges from owning individual stocks Tighten restrictions on gifts and privately funded travel (yes, Justice Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you) Overhaul the broken recusal process (once again looking at you, Justice Thomas) Create new tools to hold judges accountable for ethical misconduct And here’s one reason why rooting corruption out of the judiciary is so powerfully important: the public’s trust in our judicial system is plummeting. When someone has their day in court, they shouldn’t have to wonder whether the judge in front of them is making decisions based on their financial interests rather than the rule of law. But that’s exactly what our current setup enables. And it’s crying out for reform. I’ll keep fighting to clean house and restore public confidence in the courts by passing the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act. But I can’t do it alone.** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren for Senate All content © 2023 Warren for Senate, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

subject: In the midst of all the struggles facing our nation and our planet, we cannot simply remain on the defensive.

body:
I'm writing to ask you to split a contribution between Pramila Jayapal and the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC. Together we must continue organizing to elect progressive candidates across the country who will take on the billionaire class and fight for justice. This is important.
#
Peter,
We are engaged in many struggles right now for the future of our country and our planet. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few.
But it is not all doom and gloom, Peter. One thing that makes me optimistic about the future is that there are more really strong young progressives — often people of color — in the House now than ever before.
But we cannot stop here.
We need to continue electing candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. And in order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.
[**So today, I am asking you to join me in supporting strong progressive candidates across the country by splitting a contribution between Pramila Jayapal and the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42537?refcode=em20230623-2632&t=1&akid=2632%2E420207%2E_CjuT6)
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42537?refcode=em20230623-2632&t=20&akid=2632%2E420207%2E_CjuT6)**
In 1991, I co-founded the Congressional Progressive Caucus alongside 5 of my colleagues because I believed that working people needed more of a voice in Congress. And today, I'm proud to see that it has grown to more than 100 members, including Pramila, and is now one of the largest caucuses in Congress.
In the midst of all the struggles facing our nation and our planet, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country. And that means electing progressive leaders who will fight to protect social security, raise the minimum wage, get big money out of politics, and guarantee health care as a human right.
But it is not going to be easy.
Big Pharma, Big Oil, and other corporate interests have in past election cycles spent many millions of dollars attacking progressive candidates.
The good news is that despite the avalanche of right-wing spending, we have still been able to elect many strong candidates like Pramila.
The bad news is that some excellent progressive candidates have been defeated by this right-wing money.
It should not be a radical proposition to say that the very wealthiest people in this country should not be able to control our political system and who represents us in government.
This great nation and its government belongs to ALL of our people, not just right-wing billionaires and their Super PACs.
[**So please, split a contribution between Pramila****and the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC and help us take on the outrageous sums of money flowing into our political system.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42537?refcode=em20230623-2632&t=21&akid=2632%2E420207%2E_CjuT6)
All across the country, people are coming together and saying "enough is enough." They are tired of tinkering around the edges of the problem — on climate change, on racial justice, on economic justice.
We've already shown what's possible when working people stand together — and if we continue to do so, together we will elect a Congress that works for all of us, not just the 1%.
Thank you again for supporting Pramila and the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC if you can afford to do so.
In solidarity,
Sen. Bernie Sanders

Peter, We are engaged in many struggles right now for the future of our country and our planet. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few. But it is not all doom and gloom, Peter. One thing that makes me optimistic about the future is that there are more really strong young progressives — often people of color — in the House now than ever before. But we cannot stop here. We need to continue electing candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. And in order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country. In 1991, I co-founded the Congressional Progressive Caucus alongside 5 of my colleagues because I believed that working people needed more of a voice in Congress. And today, I'm proud to see that it has grown to more than 100 members, including Pramila, and is now one of the largest caucuses in Congress. In the midst of all the struggles facing our nation and our planet, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country. And that means electing progressive leaders who will fight to protect social security, raise the minimum wage, get big money out of politics, and guarantee health care as a human right. But it is not going to be easy. Big Pharma, Big Oil, and other corporate interests have in past election cycles spent many millions of dollars attacking progressive candidates. The good news is that despite the avalanche of right-wing spending, we have still been able to elect many strong candidates like Pramila. The bad news is that some excellent progressive candidates have been defeated by this right-wing money. It should not be a radical proposition to say that the very wealthiest people in this country should not be able to control our political system and who represents us in government. This great nation and its government belongs to ALL of our people, not just right-wing billionaires and their Super PACs. All across the country, people are coming together and saying "enough is enough." They are tired of tinkering around the edges of the problem — on climate change, on racial justice, on economic justice. We've already shown what's possible when working people stand together — and if we continue to do so, together we will elect a Congress that works for all of us, not just the 1%. Thank you again for supporting Pramila and the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC if you can afford to do so. In solidarity, Sen. Bernie Sanders | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

#
Our next major FEC deadline is exactly one week away, Peter.
In a moment, we're going to ask you to **[add a donation of any amount toward our goal of raising 30,000 individual donations to elect Lucas Kunce by midnight on June 30.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34533?refcode=em20230623-3305&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3305%2E614464%2EeWVzvU) But first, here are five reasons why your support right now is so critical:**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34533?refcode=em20230623-3305&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3305%2E614464%2EeWVzvU)**
1. **Josh Hawley is vulnerable.** Hawley won his last race with only 51% of the vote — and in the years since, his approval has dropped to just 42%. In Missouri’s last Senate race during a presidential election, the margin was just _2.7%._
2. **National Republicans are already targeting Lucas and our race.** These insiders know that if they don’t step in to tear down Lucas and make Hawley look strong, there’s a real chance they could lose this Senate seat.
3. **Missouri voters know how to take back their power at the ballot box.** In 2018, they rejected anti-union “Right-to-Work” and voted to raise the minimum wage well above the federal level. In 2020, they expanded Medicaid through the ACA. And in 2022, they legalized recreational weed.
4. **Since last quarter, Lucas has proved that our movement can harness that grassroots energy.** First, he outraised Josh Hawley by nearly 2:1. Then, he earned the support of the Missouri AFL-CIO, local and statewide leaders, and tens of thousands of everyday working people all across the country.
5. **Now, we’ve got to keep that momentum going.** This deadline is the next real chance pundits, insiders, and voters will have to assess the strength of our campaign — and we need to continue proving that we’re building the movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and take back power for everyday people.

**This is our opportunity to flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat** — and our ability to keep fighting back against the GOP insiders and corporate elites backing Josh Hawley depends on our ability to meet this goal before our June 30 deadline.
**[So Peter, will you add a donation of absolutely any amount toward our end-of-quarter goal of raising 30,000 individual donations by midnight on June 30? Lucas isn’t taking a cent from corporate PACs in this race — this movement is built by working people, for working people.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34533?refcode=em20230623-3305&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3305%2E614464%2EeWVzvU)**

Wade. | = Derek, tomorrow marks one year since the Supreme Court ended the constitutional right to an abortion by overturning Roe v. Wade. I remember so clearly how I felt that day: Angry for the millions of Americans who lost a long-held right, who saw their freedom ripped away in states that banned abortions. And motivated, more than ever before, to fight back against the radical right that celebrated while millions of Americans mourned. Derek, it’s as true today as it was a year ago: Reproductive rights are fundamental human rights, and everyone should be able to make healthcare decisions without politicians getting in the way. Derek, the overturning of Roe was just the beginning. In the year since, we’ve seen Kevin McCarthy and the GOP establishment vote to ban abortion federally, and other states have moved on to attacking contraceptives and women’s freedom. But here’s my promise to you, Derek: I will never stop fighting to restore the right to an abortion so that every single woman and girl in this country, regardless of where she lives, has full reproductive rights. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = With you in solidarity, Chris | Chris Deluzio is a voting rights lawyer and Iraq war veteran representing Pennsylvania's 17th District in Congress. body:
Last week, we were honored to stand alongside advocates and survivors at the first ever National Safer Communities Summit
#

Friends -
Last week, we were honored to stand alongside advocates and survivors at the first ever National Safer Communities Summit led by Senators Chris Murphy and Richard Blumenthal in Hartford, CT.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230623-1-15&t=1&akid=6020%2E3935704%2ENLjUs6)
It was an inspiring day where we celebrated the achievement of getting the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ signed into law last year. This historic law was the first major federal gun safety legislation passed in nearly 30 years.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230623-1-15&t=2&akid=6020%2E3935704%2ENLjUs6)
However, there’s still much more work to be done. We need to pass more solutions at the federal level—such as universal background checks and extreme risk protection orders—to keep guns out of the wrong hands and ensure the safety of our communities.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230623-1-15&t=3&akid=6020%2E3935704%2ENLjUs6)
As President Biden said at the summit: _“We are not finished. We are not finished. We are not finished.”_
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230623-1-15&t=4&akid=6020%2E3935704%2ENLjUs6)
[**As we commemorate the one year anniversary of the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ this Sunday, will you chip in $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us keep moving forward in the fight to change our country’s gun laws?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230623-1-15&t=5&akid=6020%2E3935704%2ENLjUs6)

body:

[**In the last few days of session it looks as though this Major Threat bill could still move to a vote:** **Will you take action today to urge your state lawmakers to vote no on this bill?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65295558/412972254/656980178?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQzODA5YjcwLWY5MTEtZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Bd1pZu7gMHU8ERfCEzINnpzxFyr_RKYX7DGNUTMhKAQ=&emci=1deaaecd-f611-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=43809b70-f911-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) Oregon’s unique land use laws are one of the things that makes Oregon exceptional. Thanks to our urban growth boundaries we are better than other states at preserving the natural beauty and agricultural abundance of our state. Every year we at OLCV along with our partners in the Oregon Conservation Network have to fight to protect our land use laws against big developers and other special interests attempting to pass bills that roll back these laws–bills like HB 3414A. While we fully support taking urgent action to address Oregon’s housing crisis, we know that expanding our urban growth boundaries without following the existing laws is not how we get there. This bill with the urban growth expansion included, would lead to more urban sprawl, making it harder to reduce climate pollution and address climate change. And, crossing into the wildland-urban borders will expose more Oregonians to fire risk.
