Tomorrow is a tough day, folks. It marks one full year since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and stripped away the right to choose.
In the aftermath of their decision, Republican lawmakers rushed to pass abortion bans — despite voters across the country making it clear that they support reproductive freedom.
It has been hard to see basic rights get rolled back across the country, including here in Arizona. But there's been a lot of reason for hope as well.
In conservative states like Kentucky and Kansas, ballot measures to ban abortion failed to pass by popular vote. In Minnesota and Michigan, residents elected Democratic majorities who then codified abortion protections into state law. And here in AZ-06, we saw an incredible turnout of voters supporting abortion rights on Election Day.
Last year, my opponent celebrated when the Supreme Court overturned Roe. In Congress, he's voted to restrict mifepristone, a common abortion pill, nationwide. He may run away from questions about abortion [https://twitter.com/EngelForArizona/status/1575265341109719040?s=20] , but his anti-choice stance is all too clear.
Like the majority of Americans, I believe that politicians have no place in our intimate medical decisions. And I will fight nonstop in the House to protect our abortion rights.
A year ago, we lost the right to choose. But a year from now, we have a chance to take back control of Congress and protect reproductive rights nationwide.
Winning this seat will be central to taking back the House. Last year, my campaign was outspent 6:1 — and we still came within 1% of winning. Will you make sure we can win in 2024 and fight for reproductive rights across the country by chipping in now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_foundingdonor?refcode=X_062323_Dobbs_act]

We’re at war with China.

Let me tell you how and why it’s so important that you vote for - and financially support - **clear-eyed candidates who will draw a red line in the sand when it comes to dealing with the Chinese Communist Party**.

1. Chinese-made synthetic fentanyl

First, I want to discuss why synthetic fentanyl is a major problem in this country. Last year, **more than 80,000 Americans overdosed on the deadly substance, reaching pandemic levels.** While some elected officials in Washington, D.C., are trying to pass legislation to address the problem, it’s not happening fast enough.

Earlier this month, **more than 192 pounds of CHINESE-MADE fentanyl was seized at the Arizona-Mexico border.** To put this into perspective, the amount of fentanyl seized is enough to kill more than 48 million Americans.

**Even President Obama declared a border crisis - at just one-third of the current numbers being reported.** Biden has completely ignored the border and everyday Americans are paying the costs. We need to keep our communities safe from crime and the drugs that are crossing the border.

My plan is simple:
* People whose first act to enter the country illegally **do not belong here.**
* We need to eliminate our lottery-based immigration system and **enact one based on merit.**
* If we can use our military to secure another country's border somewhere else, we can certainly **use our military to secure our own southern border** once and for all.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

I knew what awaited me yet stepping foot into the open-air drug markets of Kensington alongside Presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy on Tuesday, I felt an overwhelming sense of disbelief. The hell that flourishes on those streets, where addiction and despair intertwine, is a stark reminder of the pressing issues plaguing our nation. As I navigated through the needle-ridden paths, I couldn't help but question the stark contrast between the grand ideals we proclaim and the haunting realities faced by those living in the depths of this community. In the company of Vivek, a candidate committed to transformative change, I embarked on a journey to witness firsthand the harrowing challenges that demand our attention and collective action.
Amidst the desolation, however, I was heartened to encounter a group of human angels...
Amidst the desolation, however, I was heartened to encounter a group of human angels who dedicate themselves to alleviating the suffering in Kensington. They descended into the depths of this neighborhood, their compassion shining through as they offered aid to those who couldn't find proper medical care or simply sat down to share a heartfelt prayer. Their presence was a glimmer of hope amidst the darkness, a reminder that even in the bleakest of circumstances, humanity's capacity for empathy and kindness prevails.
Human angels descended into the depths to triage the needs of the forgotten and discarded among us
As Vivek and I continued our journey, I was filled with a renewed sense of purpose. We have witnessed the hell that persists in Kensington, but we have also witnessed the resilience and compassion that thrive within this community. They may be the forgotten and discarded among us but their voices scream out for a cure, not mere triage.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0292ddcb-3744-420d-b4bd-0a42244d8c79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Our experience in Kensington served as a powerful reminder that the challenges we face as a nation demand more than temporary solutions or mere band-aids. The voices of those trapped in the cycle of addiction and despair call out for comprehensive change, for a shift that goes beyond mere triage. It was in this spirit that Vivek joined _**The Benny Johnson Show**_ town hall that evening, where he passionately addressed the urgent need to return to the fundamental pillars that have shaped our nation: faith, family, and freedom. It became abundantly clear that the healing process for communities like Kensington requires not only a commitment to addressing immediate needs but also a profound reconnection with our core values. As we sat down with Vivek, the conversation shifted towards a vision of renewal, where faith, family, and freedom serve as guiding principles on our path to recovery and restoration.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5fdf7a8b-7edd-4db0-ab8d-8b711490615e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

During the town hall, Vivek stood alongside two courageous mothers, Laura Shanafelter and Erika Shambaugh, who have tragically lost children to fentanyl poisoning. Laura advocates tirelessly for change through _**Tyler's Law**_ , a bill named after her son, aimed at addressing the root causes of the opioid crisis and enforcing stricter penalties. Despite her unwavering efforts, the law still awaits passage, highlighting the challenges we face. Erika's heartbreaking story of losing two sons underscores the urgent need for comprehensive action. Their presence on the town hall stage showcased their strength and determination, reminding us that real lives and families are affected. Vivek listened intently, and their stories deepened his resolve to confront this crisis head-on. Their collective call for justice and change serves as a rallying cry to push for tangible solutions and put an end to the devastating toll of fentanyl poisoning.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1e034f01-e57d-45a1-9657-d710632d61b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Click to Watch](https://substack.com/redirect/1e034f01-e57d-45a1-9657-d710632d61b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As the town hall came to a close, the memory of Laura, Erika, Tyler, Joshua, and Austin lingered in the air, a constant reminder of the urgency and gravity of the work that lies ahead. Their voices, amplified through their stories, echoed the need for swift action, compassion, and unwavering commitment. It is their voices that must propel us forward, reminding us of the lives at stake and inspiring us to create a future where families are spared the unimaginable pain they have endured.
Wrapped up a busy day at the Union League in downtown Philly with a lively and inspirational townhall with Vivek and Benny Johnson

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65301280/412985240/2104862978?refcode=EM_EV_230623Raffle_TEAM_90DO_6_NG_A_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU1NzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjc2OWUwZTMtMDExMi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YvtkpBLaaIF1j52DebWqPv4e0OgqagWRylUNrXG33F4=)
Fellow Democrats,

As you know, the consequential **U.S. Senator Catherine Cortez Masto** is the speaker for our 2023 County Chairs’ Brunch, but did you know we have another exciting opportunity for you? It's also time for this year’s **Brunch Raffle!**

| | | | | Happy Pride Month, Peter. I’m Will Rollins, a former federal prosecutor and gay Democrat running to flip California’s 41st Congressional District from red to blue. [In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a $20 contribution between Blue Amp Action and our campaign to help us win this race and expand LGBTQ+ representation in Congress, but first I’ll explain why this particular seat is so important.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7dc639ea-83b5-4cc1-b741-c4c4aecaffc2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) California’s 41st District is home to Palm Springs, and last fall, we made national headlines for going head-to-head in this district against a staunch opponent of LGTBQ+ rights, Ken Calvert. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te17f3eca-eb83-47a4-a700-dca32a8dd9f7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) When it comes to LGBTQ issues, Calvert’s as bad as it gets:
* He opposed gay marriage.
* He voted against allowing gay adoptions.
* He voted down the Equality Act.
* He voted to allow employers to fire employees for being LGBTQ+.
* He voted against the repeal of “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell.”

And if all of that isn’t bad enough, his first electoral victory came in 1994 after he sent out bright pink mailers outing his then political opponent and accused him of harboring a “secret” homosexual agenda. Now Peter, the good news is Ken Calvert’s political career is more vulnerable than ever before. In 2022, I ran against him as a first-time candidate with 0% name ID, and we handed him the closest midterm election he’s ever faced (just 4 points!). National experts say that our campaign was the #3 over-performing Democratic challenger campaign in the nation. Now, in 2024, national Democrats are already calling our district one of 33 initial “offensive targets” to take back the House Majority. So let’s make a strong statement this Pride Month, Peter. Let’s send a staunch anti-LGBTQ+ Republican packing, flip this swing seat, and take back the House. [Split a contribution $20 or more between Blue Amp Action and our campaign if you’re with me »](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3717b1dc-4215-496c-a630-b45adb4e9f36/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for your support, Will Rollins

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65301639/412986697/1224595648?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjM2Mzg1Ni0wMzEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AqNHlZK312h95znzQ-bXgiqElvdt7zX66yDzffY-3io=)
Peter,

Tomorrow marks a solemn anniversary in our country. On June 24th of last year, the Supreme Court officially overturned _Roe v. Wade_ \-- throwing abortion access into crisis and slashing women’s rights in an instant.

As a father, it’s disturbing to think that my daughter now has less rights than my wife or even my mom did decades ago. And it’s unacceptable that a woman’s right to control their own body now depends on their zip code.

Even more disturbing is my opponent, Rep. Mike Garcia, and his blatant hypocrisy on the issue:

When _Roe_ was first overturned, Garcia dismissed Californians' fears and claimed that we “will continue to live under the same laws and access to abortion.”

**Then last week, Garcia voted to advance a _nationwide restriction_ on mifepristone -- a safe and widely-used abortion medication. It was buried deep in a committee bill and he hoped no one would notice.**

We noticed, Peter, and this is exactly what we’ve come to expect from Garcia. He says one thing publicly, but when push comes to shove, he votes with the most extreme wing of his party. It’s unacceptable, and he needs to be held accountable.

**The blunt truth is that our ability to restore reproductive rights could come down to what happens right here in CA-27. Rep. Garcia is the last remaining House Republican in Los Angeles County, and flipping this seat puts us on track to win back the House. But it all depends on your support:**

[**I hope you’re with me, Peter. Today, I’m asking you to chip in $3 to help us win back the House majority, and help us take a step forward in enshrining reproductive rights into federal law.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65301640/412986698/1224595648?refcode=em-6.23.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjM2Mzg1Ni0wMzEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AqNHlZK312h95znzQ-bXgiqElvdt7zX66yDzffY-3io=)

Thank you,

George

clean_body: | | | Dear Peter, It may be an odd-numbered year, but the Working Families Party has a chance to send another champion to Congress! There’s a safe Democratic seat up for grabs in Rhode Island, and we have a chance to elect a truly amazing candidate: organizer, climate lawyer, and long-time WFP champion Aaron Regunberg. And this Tuesday, June 27 at 7:30PM ET, Aaron and special guests WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell, Congressman Jamie Raskin, recording artist and activist Vanessa Carlton, and more will be throwing a virtual grassroots fundraiser to tell you how Aaron will work for working people in the House of Representatives. From winning paid sick days for hundreds of thousands of families, to making green energy affordable, to raising wages, Aaron’s always been there for working Rhode Islanders. We know he’ll continue to fight for the change that our communities need in the House of Representatives — and with his primary election less than 3 months away, this race is a major opportunity to show the nation that we’re ready for a Working Families Majority in Congress. With a Working Families Majority, we can win affordable health care, meaningful climate action, human rights protections, and more. And the first step is electing dedicated champions like Aaron. [_**In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a $5 contribution between Fight for Progress and our campaign to help us win this race and expand LGBTQ+ representation in Congress, but first I’ll explain why this particular seat is so important.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65302838/412990571/395234972?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230623-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzY2U1NGM1LTA3MTItZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rPAebp5pzP_p8_k5A17nRDs2_rUbWvkycuPqzmTKjkQ=)

California’s 41st District is home to Palm Springs, and last fall, we made national headlines for going head-to-head in this district against a staunch opponent of LGTBQ+ rights, Ken Calvert.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65302839/412990572/395234972?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230623-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzY2U1NGM1LTA3MTItZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rPAebp5pzP_p8_k5A17nRDs2_rUbWvkycuPqzmTKjkQ=)
When it comes to LGBTQ issues, Calvert’s as bad as it gets:
* He opposed gay marriage.
* He voted against allowing gay adoptions.
* He voted down the Equality Act.
* He voted to allow employers to fire employees for being LGBTQ+.
* He voted against the repeal of _“Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell.”_

And if all of that isn’t bad enough, his first electoral victory came in 1994 after he sent out bright pink mailers outing his then political opponent and accused him of harboring a “secret” homosexual agenda.

**Now Peter, the good news is Ken Calvert’s political career is more vulnerable than _ever before._**

In 2022, I ran against him as a first-time candidate with 0% name ID, and we handed him the closest midterm election he’s ever faced (just 4 points!). National experts say that our campaign was the #3 over-performing Democratic challenger campaign in the nation.

Now, in 2024, national Democrats are already calling our district one of 33 initial “offensive targets” to take back the House Majority.

Peter, Not only was Elissa Slotkin’s election for Michigan’s Seventh Congressional District super close, it was the ***MOST*** expensive race in the country. Outside groups were pouring millions of dollars into her district in an effort to flip her seat, but she had an advantage: _early money. _ The cost of television ads skyrocketed as they got closer to Election Day, but luckily Elissa had started fundraising early, so she was able to buy her airtime much sooner than her opponent, before the price went up. That meant she had more money to do things like canvassing, voter registration drives, and digital ads. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65303688/412994063/691330013?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk286-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YTk3ZmE0ZS0wYTEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lw_RqRjoG2gFYZxWEP9NMTQ0Ga4MSBSQNWnAVIEiMxw=)
Friend,

On the lapel of my suits (suits that I admit are sometimes rumpled), I wear a pin depicting a yellow canary in a birdcage. It was given to me decades ago by a Lorain steelworker at a Workers' Memorial Day rally – and to this day**, I wear this canary instead of the official Senate pin. Let me tell you why:**
In the early days of the 20th century, coal miners would bring canaries deep into the mines to warn them of poisonous gasses. Back then, workers didn't have a union strong enough or a government that _cared enough_ to protect them.
Together, we changed that. We passed worker safety laws and overtime pay. We banned child labor. We passed clean air and safe drinking water laws. We enacted Social Security and Medicare, and workers’ rights and women’s rights and civil rights. Because when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work, friend.
**I wear my canary pin as a symbol of all the progress we've made and as a reminder that our fight for the Dignity of Work – _all_ work – is far from over. ****This fight is why I'm running for reelection.**
**To defend my seat and keep up this important fight, I need grassroots support from folks like you. That's why I'm personally asking: **[Please, friend, will you give $5 or more now so we can win in Ohio, protect our Democratic Senate majority, and continue making progress for workers and families across the country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65303689/412994064/691330013?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk286-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YTk3ZmE0ZS0wYTEyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lw_RqRjoG2gFYZxWEP9NMTQ0Ga4MSBSQNWnAVIEiMxw=)
Thank you. I'm humbled to have folks like you standing alongside me in this fight.

In solidarity,

Sherrod

body:
Dear Peter,
We recently won a small victory: Adam Schiff was censured by the House of Representatives.
There are stars on the walls of the Intelligence Agencies. Each star represents an Intelligence Officer killed in action for defending our nation. Politicians like Adam Schiff wrap themselves in the valor of the fallen to give credibility to their selfish quests for power.
Schiff encapsulates the corruption in our nation's capital. He is just one reason why the American people distrust our institutions.
I worked in the Intelligence Community, and I know that reform is needed. I will work to make these agencies accountable to the American people.
My filing deadline is coming up at Midnight on June 30th. Can you please help my campaign with a contribution today?
Show your support at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/3g892sjorxlxUXjtzpiwbHsg/YOVv892SGTgtQrFtwVooft4Q).
In the last election, I lost by less than **one percentage point** to Marie Perez. She tows the Democrat Party line and does nothing to stand up to the corrupt interests ruling our country.
You can help ensure I am not outspent by special interests by donating at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/BOHNct7UYmKe4pobl0Twxg/YOVv892SGTgtQrFtwVooft4Q).
We need leaders who understand how the Intelligence Community operates and will fight the corruption in D.C. I will work to restore the American people's trust in our institutions.
But this mission can only succeed if we are able to raise the money to go on offense! Please contribute at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/BOHNct7UYmKe4pobl0Twxg/YOVv892SGTgtQrFtwVooft4Q) to help us hit our goal before the month ends!
Respectfully,
Joe Kent
P.S. - Marie Perez voted against holding Adam Schiff accountable for lying to the American people. Please help elect a common sense conservative by donating today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/3g892sjorxlxUXjtzpiwbHsg/YOVv892SGTgtQrFtwVooft4Q).

name: Dr. Shawn Wilson for Governor
subject: A busy week: Endorsements, Juneeteenth & more
body:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/swlogo2.png]
TEAM WILSON WEEKLY UPDATES
Peter,
It was another busy, informative and fun week on the campaign trail. With Juneteenth and Father’s Day to kick things off, I knew we were in for some quality time spent interacting with Louisianans and hearing about what matters most to them . I was also proud to add three more endorsements from leaders and changemakers from across our great state.
HIGHLIGHTS FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL
West Feliciana
I attended a wonderful meet & greet in West Feliciana at the Independence Baptist Church. Thank you to Pastor Elijah Lewis and friends.
We were joined by Sheriff Brian Spillman, and Councilmember Melvin Young and talked about all kinds of issues, but most importantly the ability to get things done by working together.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20%2896%29.png]
Baton Rouge
Thursday was a beautiful day to visit with Southern University board members at their annual retreat.
It is always a treat to visit with my former professor Dr. Leon Tarver and it was wonderful to have the opportunity to talk about the important work I was able to do for and with Southern University.
As Governor, I will always stand with our universities.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20%2897%29.png]
Covington
I was proud to share about the importance of voting at the Juneteenth celebration in Covington.
Thank you to Covington Councilmember Peter Lewis and his volunteers for the excellent planning of this year's Juneteenth events!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20%2898%29.png]
St. James
Thank you to Sharon Lavigne and Rise St. James [https://risestjames.org/] for giving me an opportunity to speak at your Juneteenth Celebration, Teach-in, and Crawfish Boil.
As Secretary of Louisiana’s Department of Transportation and Development I was dedicated to finding smarter, greener, and cleaner ways to develop our communities and that’s exactly what I’ll do as Governor! Protecting our environment and ensuring healthy jobs should be a top priority.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20%2899%29.png]
Shreveport
Thank you Paul Pratt for hosting a packed crowd for our fundraiser in Shreveport last Thursday!
Our movement is growing with no sign of slowing down.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20%28100%29.png]
Lafayette
Thank you to Susannah Johnson Malbreaux and Pastor Abram Freeman for the honor of serving as the keynote speaker for the SWLA Juneteenth Committee. Rocki and I enjoyed the evening’s program and pageant. Congratulations to all the winners!
As Governor, my administration will honor the values celebrated on Juneteenth and protect freedom for all Louisianans.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-23T092057.766.png]
ENDORSEMENTS
STATE SENATOR CLEO FIELDS
"Dr. Shawn Wilson shares my passion for securing healthcare, jobs, and education for the middle class and underserved communities," said State Sen. Cleo Fields. "He is the candidate who most accurately represents Louisiana as a whole, one who searches for the solutions that benefit the majority of Louisianans, understands both rural and urban populations, and has served under both Democratic and Republican administrations. I’m proud to endorse him and get to work."
I am honored to have the endorsement of State Sen. Cleo Fields, a true champion for the people. With his support rallying voters in Baton Rouge, I know we can accomplish what is right for Louisiana.
https://www.wilsonforla.com/sen-cleo-fields-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor [https://www.wilsonforla.com/sen-cleo-fields-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor]
FORMER U.S. SENATOR MARY LANDRIEU
"Dr. Shawn Wilson has been one of the most effective leaders Louisiana has had in recent history. The billions of dollars he helped secure from federal programs as Louisiana’s Department of Transportation and Development Secretary have shaped our great state's growth and development for the better. His willingness to work with anyone to accomplish commonsense improvements for Louisianans will serve our state even better when he is elected Governor."
I am proud to have secured the endorsement of former US Senator Mary Landrieu. Mary comes from a family of political changemakers and has left an undeniable mark on Louisiana as a whole for good. I am honored to have her support for my candidacy.
https://www.wilsonforla.com/former-u-s-senator-mary-landrieu-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor [https://www.wilsonforla.com/former-u-s-senator-mary-landrieu-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor]
CIVIL RIGHTS ACTIVIST AND FORMER US SENATE CANDIDATE GARY CHAMBERS JR.
I am proud to announce that Civil Rights activist and former US Senate candidate Gary Chambers Jr. has endorsed my candidacy for Governor [https://secure.numero.ai/contribute/GaryChambers] . I was grateful to attend his Civics For the People event in May, where informing our electorate was the goal. Gary is a natural coalition builder with a grassroots movement behind him and I am grateful for his support.
"I have nothing but admiration for the way in which Dr. Shawn Wilson brings people from the entire political spectrum to accomplish his goals. The people of Louisiana, especially vulnerable populations have all benefited from the thoughtful detail and ambition Dr. Wilson utilized working for state government. I am optimistic about how well that will translate as the state's top executive. Our people will make significant progress by electing Dr. Shawn Wilson as Governor."
https://www.wilsonforla.com/civil-rights-activist-and-former-u-s-senate-candidate-gary-chambers-jr-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor [https://www.wilsonforla.com/civil-rights-activist-and-former-u-s-senate-candidate-gary-chambers-jr-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor]
UPCOMING EVENTS
Join #TeamWilson at the Freedom Fund Banquet by the Louisiana NAACP on Saturday, July 24th from 7-10 PM at Xavier University’s University Center Grand. Get tickets here. [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/naacp-new-orleans-branch-107th-year-freedom-fund-banquet-tickets-591869295997?aff=oddtdtcreator]
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/naacp-new-orleans-branch-107th-year-freedom-fund-banquet-tickets-591869295997?aff=oddtdtcreator [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/naacp-new-orleans-branch-107th-year-freedom-fund-banquet-tickets-591869295997?aff=oddtdtcreator]
The Northshore Democratic Women’s Club will host Dustin Granger, candidate for Treasurer, and I for a candidate forum on Sunday, June 25 from 3-5 PM at Abita Springs Town Hall.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/dustin%20and%20wilson.png]
To learn more about my candidacy visit wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com] .
With hope,
Shawn Wilson

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." body:
Mr. Kennedy asks us: “Who do we want to be? A nation of war, or a nation of peace?”

| [ ](http://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, Mr. Kennedy asks us: “Who do we want to be? A nation of war, or a nation of peace?” This week, [**Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. made a defining speech**](https://www.kennedy24.com/a_nation_of_war_or_a_nation_of_peace?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=2) to set a new direction for American foreign policy in his administration and beyond. He called for peace, diplomacy, and an end to the forever wars, based on a radically different vision of ourselves and the world. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/a_nation_of_war_or_a_nation_of_peace?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=3) [Speech Transcript](https://www.kennedy24.com/peace_and_diplomacy?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=4) Mr. Kennedy’s call for peace echoes one of the most famous peace speeches of all time: his uncle President John F. Kennedy’s address at American University 60 years ago this month at the height of the Cold War. In calling for de-escalation and diplomacy with Russia, Mr. Kennedy invoked deeper principles – the ideological foundations of the mentality of endless war. Here are two statements with enduring relevance. “We have been immersed in a foreign policy discourse that is all about adversaries and threats and allies and enemies and domination.” “We’ve become addicted to comic book good versus evil narratives that erase complexity and blind us to the legitimate motives and legitimate economic concerns and the legitimate security concerns of other people and other nations.” Mr. Kennedy made it clear that this is not merely an issue of foreign policy. He said, “**Is it any wonder that as America has waged violence throughout the world, violence has overtaken us in our own nation?** It has not come as an invasion. It has come from within. Our bombs, our drones, our armies are incapable of stopping gun violence on our streets and in our schools, or domestic violence in our homes. I see the same link here as my father and Martin Luther King saw about the Vietnam War. They believed that we could not have warfare abroad without bringing that violence home to our streets, to our attitudes, to our communities. Foreign violence is inseparable from domestic violence.” Kennedy asks us all, as individuals and as a nation: **"Is this really who we are? Is this what we want to be? Is that what America's Founders envisioned?"** Is this who we are? That is up to us to decide. [**You can help choose peace by supporting the peace candidate Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=5) Donate to our campaign and help put Mr. Kennedy into the White House! Thanks again for your support. Team Kennedy
[](http://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=6)[http://www.kennedy24.com/](http://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=7) Footnotes: [**Link to Full Peace video**](https://www.kennedy24.com/major_address_peace_diplomacy?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech_623&n=8) :_Robert F. HELP BERNIE HIT HIS FIRST QUARTERLY DEADLINE My team and I have set an aggressive goal for this first quarter – that’s what it will take to defeat career insider Democrat Sherrod Brown and the leftist special interests working to keep him in office. We have a long way to go to reach this goal, which is why I need your support starting now so we can begin closing the gap. Thank you, Bernie Moreno Republican for U.S. Senate Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. Friend, Auto insurance discrimination keeps our residents in a cycle of poverty. Non driving factors being used in calculating car insurance is just proxy to discriminate against communities like ours. One’s education level, zip code, marital status, and credit score determine your auto insurance rates. **Yet, drivers in Black and working class neighborhoods regularly face higher auto insurance rates than others.** A University of Michigan Poverty Solutions study showed that someone with a drinking under the influence violation but had a higher credit score paid three times less than someone with a clean driving record but a lower credit score. That is absolutely ridiculous and shows that the auto insurance industry is discriminating and hiding behind these non-driving factors. **That’s why I’ve re-introduced the**** _Prohibit Auto Insurance Discrimination Act_****(****_PAID Act_****), to continue the critical work of dismantling systemic racism and building a more equitable and just nation.** [**The**** _PAID Act_****would ensure insurance companies only use driving related factors when determining car insurance rates and eligibility. Non driving factors being used in calculating car insurance is just proxy to discriminate against communities like ours. One’s education level, zip code, marital status, and credit score determine your auto insurance rates. Yet, drivers in Black and working class neighborhoods regularly face higher auto insurance rates than others. A University of Michigan Poverty Solutions study showed that someone with a drinking under the influence violation but had a higher credit score paid three times less than someone with a clean driving record but a lower credit score. That is absolutely ridiculous and shows that the auto insurance industry is discriminating and hiding behind these non-driving factors. That’s why I’ve re-introduced the Prohibit Auto Insurance Discrimination Act(PAID Act), to continue the critical work of dismantling systemic racism and building a more equitable and just nation. | The PAID Act would bar the use of the following when calculating insurance rates: Education level Employment status and occupation Home ownership status or marital status Credit score / consumer report Gender Zip code or adjacent zip codes Census tract Previous insurer information This bill would also empower the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to enforce these prohibitions. But the attorney general’s office said it wasn't satisfied it wouldn’t be used to out LGBTQ students, and the parties are due back in court next week, ...But Then They Move on to Civics Right now, extremists are focusing on removing age-appropriate health information from school curricula, including discussions of sex ed and gender identity, because they know these are effective wedge issues. But while this fight is starting with sex ed, it’s not going to stop there. Case in point: As you know, MAGA candidates won a majority on the Ridge High School BOE. This year, the extremist majority has rejected not one, but two high school sociology textbooks, ones widely used across the US, because board members personally disagree with their accurate portrayal of current events. . A timeline: March 2023: Teachers' new textbook recommendation, "Sociology: A Brief Introduction," by Richard T. Schaefer, failed to advance past the board's curriculum committee after being viewed as biased by the committee's extremist members. April 2023: The board's extremists led a 5-4 vote to reject the teachers' second choice, "The Real World: An Introduction to Sociology," by Kerry Ferris and Jill Stein, after that was also faulted as biased. June 12, 2023: The extremist majority agreed to have the full board give the Schaefer book a second look as a potential alternative to the current text. June 22, 2023: The Schaefer book went down in a 4-3 board vote along ideological lines, with Board President Keith Molinari, Kirsten Light, Larry Rascio and Csilla Csipak - all identified with the extremist faction - voting for denial, while Robin McKeon, Timothy Salmon, and Jennifer White voted for approval. These mini-MAGA candidates told members of their community they were running on fiscal responsibility, keeping schools academically excellent, and supporting students. Instead, they’re wasting taxpayer money on legal fees, destroying teacher morale, trying to manipulate the curriculum to align with their personal political views and silence opposing viewpoints and perspectives–and by censoring free and open discussions of current events and other topics, destroying the academic excellence they claim they want to uphold. clean_body: Will you join me? | | | | | Wow, friend. I just got off the stage with my friend, Tom Kean, Jr., at his re-election campaign kickoff event. Let me tell you, it was electric. In just six short months, Congressman Kean has established himself as a rising star and a key member of the Republican Conference.We need Tom Kean, Jr. in Congress. The crowd tonight was fired up and excited to get to work re-electing Rep. Kean and keeping up the fight to make sure NJ-07 stays red. As you probably already know, this district was CRITICAL to winning our House Majority - which paved the way for us, with Rep. Kean’s help - to pass many pieces of historic legislation... and we’re only getting started. Because of that, National Liberal Groups and super PACs have already committed massive amounts of money to this race more than a year out from the election. DEFEND THE REPUBLICAN MAJORITY: I won’t sugarcoat this, friend. New Jersey’s 7th is going to be THE battleground district of the 2024 election. We’re going to need all hands on deck to defend our majority, and it’ll all be going down right. In. This. District. There’s no doubt this district will be on the frontlines of defending the House. That’s why it is so important for each and every one of us to come together and lend our support to Tom Kean, Jr. in any way we’re able.
